[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Power Plant Buildings[ENDCOLOR] can produce [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity resource to keep your city functioning. Some buildings also require a certain amount of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity to build. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These buildings can be built in cities at any population size level. However, most Power Plant Buildings require strategic resources to build and will cause [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Pollution[ENDCOLOR] - Pollution will slow down the city's population growth. To solve the pollution problem, you should consider building [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Public Health and Sanitary Service buildings[ENDCOLOR].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You must always have enough Power Plant Buildings to make your empire run. Because affter entering the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Modern Era[ENDCOLOR]. Your cities will consume [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity accrodign to their population size. If your empire is lacking of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity, the [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, [ICON_RESEARCH] Science and [ICON_GOLD] Gold output will greatly decrease nationwide. Otherwise, if you have abundant [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity, you will receive bonus for the [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, [ICON_RESEARCH] Science and [ICON_GOLD] Gold output nationwide.

[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Public Health and Sanitary Service buildings[ENDCOLOR] can increase the city's population growth speed by filling the [ICON_FOOD] Food growth slot after a new [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen is born. However they are not Fod Production buildings. They cannot directly boost the city's [ICON_FOOD] Food output.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Public Health and Sanitary Service buildings can also reduce the [ICON_FOOD] Food growth loss due to pollution in the city. However, they cannot completely remove the pollution but only to ease the problem.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Public Health and Sanitary Service buildings are designed to make the large cities to grow even larger, or fight against pollution. As a result, they must be built in cities reached the certain population size level. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These buildings will cost additional [ICON_GOLD] Gold for maintenance according to the city's population.

[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Public Transport Buildings[ENDCOLOR] are designed to hadle the traffic problems in large city. As a result, they can greatly improve the [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production output in the city by reducing people's commute time. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Public Transport Buildings must be built in cities reached the certain population size level. Also they will cost a large amount of [ICON_GOLD] Gold for maintenance. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fortunately, you can also earn additional [ICON_GOLD] Gold by tickets fee.

In SuperPower Mod, your people are not statistics, they will consume a certain amount of consumer product in their daily lives. As a result, Consumer Goods are very important. The amount of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods you own will affect the global [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness of your nation directly.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1. The use of Consumer Goods: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]City population size. Larger cities will consume more [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]City level: Cities further away from your [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital will consume more [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]International Trade Units and Settlers.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]2. How to acquire Consumer Goods: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Merchant specialists in your cities will produce lots of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods, which is its main source. (+4 [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods per Merchant, upgradable by certain policies) [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some buildings with an icon of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] will provide a small amount of Consumer Goods on their own. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You may also acquire Consumer Goods from other civilizations by trading or allied city-states.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]3. The Global Effects of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the number of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods is negative (lower than [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]0[ENDCOLOR]), your people will be very unhappy due to unable to purchase their daily products and cause huge unhappiness penalty by percentage (from +5% [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness to +50% [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness) according to the total number of cities you own. Here is the math: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]P= n*(c/10) [NEWLINE](P:the additional percentage of [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] unhappiness caused by the number of negative [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods; n:the number of negative [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods; c: the total number of cities you own)
[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]On the contrary, if you have abundant [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods (more than [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]25[ENDCOLOR]), the total unhappiness of your nation will decrease by percentage (maximum -50%[ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness). What's more, you will also receive a bonus for the [ICON_GOLD] income of [ICON_TRADE] trade routes (maximum +50%, can multiply with other effects). Both positive effects are scaled according to the total number of cities you own. Here is the math: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]P= n/c [NEWLINE](P:the reduced percentage of [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness, or the additional percentage of [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_TRADE] trade routes; n:the number of [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods you currently have; c: the total number of cities you own)
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For example, if you have [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]50[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods and own 5 cities. You will receive a bonus of -10% [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness and +10% [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_TRADE] trade routes (P=50/5=10). If you have [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]-50[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_RES_CONSUMER] Consumer Goods, you will receive a penalty of +25% [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness (P=50*(5/10)=25).

Consumer goods are goods that are ultimately consumed rather than used in the production of another good. For example, a microwave oven or a bicycle which is sold to a consumer is a final good or consumer good, whereas the components which are sold to be used in those goods are called intermediate goods.

In SuperPower Mod, after entering the Modern Era, the Electricity System will be functional. [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity is a very important resource in the late-game. A modern civilization cannot survive without enough power supply.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1. The use of Electricity: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]City population size. Larger cities will consume more [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Almost every post-industrial building requires a certain amount of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity to be built.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]2. How to acquire Electricity: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Power Plants buildings (with an icon of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY]) is the only source of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity. Be aware that most of the Power Plants buildings will cause Pollution to the city which slow down the population growth. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You may also acquire [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity from other civilizations by trading or allied city-states.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]3. The Global Effects of Electricity:
[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the number of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity is negative (lower than [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]0[ENDCOLOR]), you will receive [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science penalty by percentage (maximum -50%[ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science output nationwide) according to the total number of cities you own. Here is the math: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]P= n*(c/10) [NEWLINE](P:the additional percentage of [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science penalty caused by the number of negative [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity; n:the number of negative [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity; c: the total number of cities you own)
[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]On the contrary, if you have abundant [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity (more than [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]25[ENDCOLOR]), you will receive [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science bonus by percentage (maximum +50%[ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science output nationwide) according to the total number of cities you own. Here is the math: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]P= n/c [NEWLINE](P:the additional percentage of [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science penalty caused by the number of [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity you currently have; n:the number of negative [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity; c: the total number of cities you own)
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For example, if you have [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]50[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity and own 5 cities. You will receive a bonus of +10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science output (P=50/5=10). If you have [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]-50[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_RES_ELECTRICITY] Electricity, you will receive a penalty of -10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_RESEARCH] Science output (P=50*(5/10)=25).

Electric power is the rate at which electrical energy is transferred by an electric circuit. The SI unit of power is the watt, one joule per second.Electric power is usually produced by electric generators, but can also be supplied by sources such as electric batteries. It is generally supplied to businesses and homes by the electric power industry through an electric power grid. Electric power is usually sold by the kilowatt hour (3.6 MJ) which is the product of power in kilowatts multiplied by running time in hours. Electric utilities measure power using an electricity meter, which keeps a running total of the electric energy delivered to a customer.

In SuperPower Mod, military units and world wonders require a certain amount of [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower to maintain. If you have abundant [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower, the [ICON_GOLD] Gold cost for purchasing units and buildings will be reduced due to the lower cost of labor value.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1. The use of Manpower: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Building regular army units. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Building World Wonders.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]2. How to acquire Manpower: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cities will provide lots of [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower, which is its main source. Cities with larger population sizes will provide more [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Engineer specialists in your cities will produce a small amount of [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower. (+2 [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower per Engineer) [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some buildings with an icon of [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower will provide a small amount of Consumer Goods on their own. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You may also acquire [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower from other civilizations by trading or allied city-states.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]3. The Global Effects of Manpower: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you have abundant [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower (more than [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]25[ENDCOLOR]), you will receive a discount for the [ICON_GOLD] cost for purchasing units and buildings according to the total number of cities you own (maximum -35%, can multiply with other effects). Here is the math: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]P= n/(c*2)*5 (round down by 5) [NEWLINE](P:the discount percentage of [ICON_GOLD] cost for purchasing units and buildings; n:the number of [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower you currently have; c: the total number of cities you own)
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For example, if you have [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]50[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower and own 5 cities. You will receive a bonus of -25% [ICON_GOLD] cost for purchasing units and buildings (P=50/(5*2)*5=25).
In SuperPower Mod, the deep ocean without any resources can also be improved by digging out Natural Gas. It will provide additional [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production output of the plot.

Natural gas is a naturally occurring hydrocarbon gas mixture consisting primarily of methane, but commonly including varying amounts of other higher alkanes, and sometimes a small percentage of carbon dioxide, nitrogen, hydrogen sulfide, or helium.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strategic Weapon [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Medic [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Flagship
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Automatically resupply its Carrier-based Aircraft (One Aircraft Unit per turn) when it is inside Friendly Territory. After gaining the "Carrier Supply III" promotion, it can resupply its Carrier-based Aircraft even outside Friendly Territory. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]EXP earned by its Carrier-based Aircraft will transfer to the Aircraft Carrier. So the Aircraft Carrier will earn the promotions. Even the Carrier-based Aircraft are all shot down, those promotions will not lose. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]New Carrier-based Aircraft added to the Aircraft Carrier CANNOT move until the next turn and it will automatically inherit all available promotions in the next turn. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]if the Aircraft Carrier is destroyed, it will lose all of its Carrier-based Aircraft on board. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Carrier-based Aircraft is allowed to rebase to other Aircraft Carriers but the promotions will NOT be transferred with the aircraft. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]For the Game balance other than the reality, Carrier-based Aircraft are not allowed to rebase to cities. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]When clicking "Order ALL UNITS" button on the left, all Aircraft Carriers will instantly switch to "intercept" mode. However if its HP is lower than 30, it will sleep and heal till its HP is full.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A floating weapons platform [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Highly Versatile [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can heal other units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Extremely expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Combat preparations takes a long time [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poor mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If running out of its Carrier-based Aircraft, it is totally useless
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aircraft Carriers are the symbol of a modern navy. It is a strategic weapon. In the late game, one Super-Carrier is enough to defeat a small nation without enough anti-air forces. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Newly built Aircraft Carriers are empty. You have to wait for a few turns for its Carrier-based Aircraft fully loaded. So build them ahead of time! [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aircraft Carriers must be accompanied by a full carrier battle group to make full use of its power. One single Aircraft Carrier is easy to be outnumbered and destroyed. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]One carrier battle group able for continental warfare can includes 2-4 Aircraft Carriers, 1-3 Battleship(s), 2-5 Cruisers, 8-12 Destroyers, 6-9 Submarines. 1-2 Great Admirals(s). [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Since every Carrier-based Aircraft's attack will transfer its EXP to its Carrier, Aircraft Carrier will earn new promotions rapidly if engaged in a full fight. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Needless to say, Aircraft Carriers are the most valued units. Protect your experienced Aircraft Carriers at all costs if you want to win the war. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Submarines have great combat bonuses to quickly paralyze them. Aircraft Carriers are not as tough as you may expect. They can be destroyed by 3-4 Submarines in one turn. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you have enough anti-air powers, enemy Aircraft Carriers cannot cause too much damage. Land-based Fighters have higher combat strength, thus they can easily defeat Carrier-based Aircraft during a dogfight. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aircraft Carriers in deep ocean can be nuked without the fear of nuclear winter.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Assassin [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pusher
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is a Land-based Aircraft so it cannot land on [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Aircraft Carriers[ENDCOLOR].
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the attack is successful, it can destroy any land or naval units of its era in one shot [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Receive little damage when attacking units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can easily take out enemy garrisoned units or aircraft in the city
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weak when intercepted [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Relatively short flight range
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Since its attacks ignore all terrain or any defensive bonus, it is extremely efficient to take down enemy units hiding in rough terrains like deep forest or jungles. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Attack Aircraft also have a deadly effect attacking enemy naval ships. With enough Attack Aircraft accompanied by Fighters, you are able to take out the enemy fleet while your main naval force is out. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]With "Surgical Strike" promotions, Attack Aircraft can even damage or destroy enemy units in the city. Be aware they can damage or destroy enemy aircraft stationed in the target city as well. Use Fighters to clear a path and your Attack Aircraft can wipe out enemy air force on their runways in one turn. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Rember to perform an "Air Sweep" everytime before launching an air strike. The intercepting range of Fighters is very long. You will never know how many enemy Fighters hiding in the fog of war. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Move up your Attack Aircraft while pushing further, since they have a relatively shorter flight range. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Attack Aircraft don't have any anti-air weapons. As a result, they are perfect targets for Fighters. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A land Anti-air Unit or Military Airbase (Citadel Unit) may not be able to shoot down an Attack Aircraft during interception. But it will cause severe damage to the Attack Aircraft and protect your unit under its attack. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A Heavy Cruiser or a Missile Cruiser is able to shoot down an Attack Aircraft during interception if it has "Flak Cannon I" promotion.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Initiator [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Support [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Air Supremacy Control
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is a Land-based Aircraft so it cannot land on [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Aircraft Carriers[ENDCOLOR]. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]For the Game balance other than the reality, it can NOT attack land or naval units. However, you can still use the "Airstrike" button on the left to show its intercepting range. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]When clicking the "Order ALL UNITS" button on the left, all fighter units will instantly switch to "intercept" mode. However if its HP is lower than 30, it will sleep and heal till its HP is full. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]While performing "Air Sweep" it can damage or even destroy enemy intercepting aircraft, land and sea AA units.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can shoot down anything of the same era in the sky [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Long intercepting range
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can only engage in air combat
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You must have enough Fighters to control the sky if you want to win a modern war. However do not build excessively since it can not do substantial damage to your enemy. Otherwise, you may not have enough manpower to build attack aircraft. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Remember to perform an "Air Sweep" before launching an air strike. The intercepting range of Fighters is very long. You will never know how many enemy are Fighters hiding in the fog of war. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is always wise to promote your Fighters with "Dogfight" promotion first, since the Fighters top priority is controlling airspace. This will also help them to survive dogfights to have more time for further promotions. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always keep your Fighters upgraded to the most advanced models. Dated Fighters will suffer a crushing defeat fighting against advanced Fighters due to the huge gap in their combat strength and flight range. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Protect your experienced Fighters. An ACE pilot can comfortably shoot down three rookies from the sky in one turn. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The most effective method against enemy Fighters is to build more Fighters or build advanced Fighters to overwhelm the enemy. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]AA units are not so effective against enemy Fighters, however they can buy you some time. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Military Airbase (Citadel Unit) can be attacked by the enemy Fighter's air sweep. But it won't cause damage.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strategic Weapon [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is a Land-based Aircraft so it cannot land on [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Aircraft Carriers[ENDCOLOR].
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the attack is successful, It can quickly put a nation back to the Stone Age [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Global strikes capable [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannot be stopped by the enemy land or naval anti-air units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Extremely expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]After a few bombardments, it can offer you a useless captured city
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]This is a strategic weapon, which will destroy your enemy war capability instead of killing units. it is not designed to win a battle but to win a war. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strategic Bombers' "Napalm Bomb" Promotions can cause catastrophic civilian casualties to enemy cities, which will prove to be a great impact to your opponent's economy. What's more, it can reduce the resistance time of your newly captured city, in an inhumane way. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use its "Air Siege I" promotion to destroy enemy military production to paralyze the war capability. What's more, the target city will be more vulnerable after its military buildings destroyed. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you want to bring further impact to your enemy economy, use Strategic Bombers with "Air Siege II" and "Air Siege III" promotions to bomb enemy main cities to destroy its production buildings and power plants. This is especially effective if you want to stop your opponent from launching spaceship. However, if you want to capture and make use of the target city, do not do so. Otherwise you will destroy your own buildings. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strategic Bombers can also be used for tactical bombing by gaining "Supply Line Bombardment" which can cause chaos to enemy invading units, especially for enemy naval units.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Land and sea AA units are not able to stop the Strategic Bombers. Only Fighters of the same era can intercept and shoot down these huge aircraft. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can build Bomb Shelters in you main cities to minimize the civilian casualty, but it cannot prevent building loss. Unfortunately Bomb Shelters will consume additional electricity and expensive maintenance cost. This is another way how Strategic Bombers impact the opponent's economy as strategic weapons.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Initiator [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nuker
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]As long as other friendly units can see the target and it is within the attacking range, it is attackable. Even this unit cannot see the target.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Longest firing range [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weapon of mass destruction [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can break a deadlock in a battle [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Effective vs enemy naval units for its range and AOE effects [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you have enough of them, you can achieve similar effects as using nuclear weapons but much more environment-friendly
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very Expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Worst mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very weak in defending itself [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Must work with escort units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No bonus attacking cities
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]These weapons with AoE Effect can damage multiple enemy units in one shot. So open fire at crowds! [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Their long firing range can be used against naval ships near the coast, which is the only way that land force can have the change to deal with the naval force in a fair fight. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pick your target wisely for efficiency. Do not waste their firepower on low value targets like militias. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always work with Hit-and-run Units with "Scouting" promotions to have the best effect. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Special Forces Units can offer "Target Guide" for this unit to boost its damage. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Without doubt, they are high value units and should never go out alone. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are very weak in melee combat, which means any melee units in the same era can easily kill them in one hit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are very slow, so you have plenty of time for counter attack. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Separate your groups of units to minimize the loss, if enemy AoE bombardment is unavoidable. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Although they cannot capture your city, your citizens in the city will be killed by their ranged attacks once the city HP is 0. So get rid of them ASAP!

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Initiator [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Disabler [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Support
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If gained "Fire Support" promotions and stacked with an Infantry Unit, an Counter Unit, a Citadel Unit or a Militia Unit, this unit will automatically launch a Counter-attack at the enemy unit attacking at this plot. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If it successfully put the debuff an enemy unit or your unit gets a debuff by the enemy attack. You will hear a special sound effect and get a notice on the right side of the screen.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can disable enemy units and create chaos [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Good price to performance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Versatile
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Low Combat Strength [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very weak in defending itself [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Must work with escort units
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Archery Units and Anti-air Units are very different from their counterparts in BNW. They are no longer main force units as they should be. They are support units and must work with other units for a better output. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Units with "Suppression" Promotions can paralyze any enemy units. Use it to disable strong enemies which cannot be killed in the current turn. This is very helpful if you are outnumbered. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The perfect defensive formation: stack an Infantry Unit, an Counter Unit, a Citadel Unit or a Militia Unit with a Ranged Unit which has "Fire Support" promotions together during defensive turns. The enemy Infantry Units, Hit-and-run Units will suffer huge casualties if they dare to attack your position. However, it is useless against Siege Units' bombardment. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always work with Hit-and-run Units with "Scouting" promotions to have the best effect. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Special Forces Units can offer "Target Guide" for this unit to boost its damage. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Comparing with the Siege Units, Archery Units and Anti-air Units are more fit with defensive missions. However they can still be very useful to eliminate enemy Counter Units to open a way for your Heavy Mounted Units and Tanks. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are very weak in melee combat, which means any melee units in the same era can easily kill them in one hit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Siege Units have longer shooting ranges and combat bonus against them. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Anti-air Units have limited firepower against Fighters or Carrier-based Aircraft. Use "Air Sweep" ability to damage or destroy them to clear a path for your air strike if your land units cannot reach them. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Although they cannot capture your city, your citizens in the city will be killed by their ranged attacks once the city HP is 0. So get rid of them ASAP!

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nuker [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Durable [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Flagship
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]As long as other friendly units can see the target and it is within the attacking range, it is attackable. Even this unit cannot see the target.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strongest Combat Strength in its era [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weapon of mass destruction [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can break a deadlock in a battle [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Longest firing range [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poor mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No escaping abilities [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weak vs Counter Units which are much cheaper
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Boasting the Strongest Combat Strength in its era, Battleships can take out most of enemy units of the same era in one shot if accompanied with enough buffs and debuffs to the target. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always work with Naval Hit-and-run Units with "Scouting" promotions to have the best effect. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Great Admirals can offer "Target Guide" for this unit to boost its damage. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]These weapons with AoE Effect can damage multiple enemy units in one shot. So open fire at crowds! [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Their long firing range can be used to offer fire support for inland forces. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pick your target wisely for efficiency. Do not waste their firepower on low value targets such as militias. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Even after the rise of naval aviation, Battleships are still useful to break a deadlock when the enemy have concentrated forces. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Battleships are expensive Naval Units and take a long time to produce. Even fresh Battleship units can cause massive damage to the enemy, which means you don't need to care about your experienced battleships too much. It is worthwhile to sacrifice your battleship to save an experienced Aircraft Carrier if necessary. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Naval Hit-and-run Units have great combat bonuses to quickly paralyze them. Battleships are very tough. You may need 5-7 Naval Hit-and-run Units of its same era to destroy a Battleship in one turn. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use the attacking range advantage of Aircraft Carriers to attack them from a safe distance. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Separate your groups of units to minimize the loss, if enemy AoE bombardment is unavoidable.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Tower [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Defense
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Fixed Unit, can NOT move. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]After finishing building a Citadel Improvement, a Citadel Unit is created on that tile Citadel. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you order your worker to change the Citadel Improvement into other kinds of Improvements, its Citadel Unit will be also removed. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the city where the Citadel is captured by the enemy, the Citadel Unit suffers -50 HP per turn and -50% [ICON_STRENGTH]Combat Strength due to lack of supply, so it will be destroyed in two turns if you don't retake that city. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Citadel units are structures indeed so they can NOT earn Promotions. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Land-based Aircraft can be deployed on the Citadel tile with a Firebase or Military Airbase.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Great Defensive Structure [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No [ICON_RES_MANPOWER] Manpower cost
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Expensive Maintenance Cost [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Citadels are static defences, and can still be flanked by enemy forces.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use its sight and firepower to keep an eye on your territory while your troops are on the frontline, especially for areas with important resources or choke points in case of possible enemy harassment. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is a relatively cheap way to deploy Land-based Aircraft outside your cities. Build them in safe areas to allow your aircraft to extend their flight range.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Like other strategy games, Siege Units have great combat bonus against Citadel Units. One Siege Units can destroy a firebase easily from a long distance. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It is a waste of time to mess with an enemy Citadel Unit not in your way. You could simply bypass it and take the enemy city directly.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Counter [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannon Fodder [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Escort
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can fortify by clicking the "Fortify" button or pressing "F". It will +50% [ICON_STRENGTH]Combat Strength whe ndefending at the beginning of the next turn. When it moves, it will lose its fortification.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very cheap compared with their countering units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent price to performance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cause less casualties if destroyed
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poor mobility
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They can defend your position from ferocious enemy charging with Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks. it is worthwhile to sacrifice one cheap Counter Unit in exchange of damaging or destroying several enemy Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are competent cannon fodder to waste enemy firepower. If necessary, order one Counter Unit to capture the city which will certainly be recaptured in the next turn to reduce your loss. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Ranged Units can destroy them easily under most circumstances. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use Siege Units to bombard enemy fortified Counter Units. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Their mobility is limited, just simply take a detour.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Core [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pusher [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Eliminator
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]When it inflicts more damage to the enemy than it receives, forces the enemy unit to withdraw. (If the enemy unit can't withdraw, it will receive additional damage.)
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Best explosiveness [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Easy to use, easy to kill [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Good mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can easily break through enemy line
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weak vs Counter Units which are much cheaper [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Lose its mobility when attacking cities [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weak in defending and can be easily outnumbered
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use them to crush enemy line. They are unstoppable against almost any other units except Counter Units. Even enemy unit cannot be killed in one hit, it can also "push" the enemy unit away to break the line or reveal other units under its protection. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If the enemy front-line is guarded with Counter Units, try to flank them. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pick your target wisely for efficiency. Do not waste their firepower on low value targets like militias. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Do not run too far, save some MPs to back to safe areas after attacking. They are vulnerable while defending. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Protect your experienced Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks. They are high value units and can fight much more efficiently than rookies. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Put some Counter Units on your flanks and guard your high value units. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]"Every man is his own worst enemy", your Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks can easily catch up and eliminate enemy Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks. It is less efficient than using Counter Units, however Counter Units can always be shaken off due to their limited mobilities. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Under the worst case, use cannon fodder units to waste enemy charge to save your high value units.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Initiator [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Ganker [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Escape [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Support
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The default "Right Click" will order the unit to perform a ranged attack. If you want it to perform a melee attack, click the "Attack" button on the left or press "A" key and click on the enemy unit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If it successfully put the debuff an enemy unit or your unit gets a debuff by the enemy attack. You will hear a special sound effect and get a notice on the right side of the screen.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can make strong enemy units much more vulnerable [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Good survivability [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Versatile
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Jack of all trades [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Low price to performance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Steep learning curve
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Hit-and-run Units are not so "easy to use" for new players. Careful plan and micro control are required to make full use of these units. You have four different ways to bring them into play. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]1. Scouting: Before attacking enemy units, send Hit-and-run Units with "Scouting" promotions to move next to the target. This will reduce the target's defense as well as providing flank bonus to make your attack more efficient. In most cases, the first Hit-and-run Units you trained should choose this promotion. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]2. Adding Debuff: If you face strong enemy units, like advanced units, elite units and experimental units, use Hit-and-run Units with "Sunder" promotions to attack them to reduce their combat strength in defence. The "sunder" effect can be multiplied to -50% combat strength, so you can kill enemy units even two eras ahead of yours. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]3. Hunt Down: Hit-and-run Units with "Hunt Down" promotions have significant combat bonus against wounded units (even a unit with 99 HP is also considered "wounded"). As a result, they are very powerful to finish up enemy debuffed or escaping units, especailly those on the other side of a river. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]4. Gank: Besides working as a support unit. A group of 3-5 Hit-and-run Units is able to work alone as a tactical team with high mobility. One unit with "Scouting" promotions provides reconnaissance, while 1-2 unit(s) with"Sunder" promotions softening the enemy and 1-3 unit(s) with "Hunt Down" promotions to finish the enemy up. Such a tactical team can defeat almost all kinds of combination of enemy units in all terrains, without any loss. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Hit-and-run Units cannot function as your main force due to their low combat strength and high training cost. Make sure they are back in safe territory by the end of your turn since they are vulnerable while defending. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Protect your experienced Hit-and-run Units. They are high value units and can fight much more efficiently than rookies. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Remember Hit-and-run Units can perform both melee attacks and ranged attacks. Use melee attacks against enemy Ranged Units while use ranged attacks for enemy melee units to minimize your casualties. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are weak while defending and can be easily defeated by your main force units. Beware that enemy units with "Hunt Down" promotions also have combat bonus while defending. You should use unit of full HP to attack them. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]With an advantage of shooting range and great combat bonus, Archery Units can easily kill enemy mounted archers while Anti-air Units can quickly bring down enemy helicopters. Stack Archery Units or Anti-air Units with Infantry Units or Counter Units to defend your flanks. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always keep a neat formation to leave no gaps the for enemy Hit-and-run Units to slip in.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Core [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Multipurpose [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Durable
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can fortify by clicking the "Fortify" button or pressing "F". It will +50% [ICON_STRENGTH]Combat Strength when defending at the beginning of the next turn. When it moves, it will lose its fortification.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strong combat strength [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent price to performance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Versatile [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Durable and heals quickly
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Limited mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No escaping abilities
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you are building up an army, but don't know which unit you should choose, train an infantry unit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Infantry Units are competent for both aggressive and defensive missions. In rough terrains, they can even outrun Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always stay in groups for flanking bonus. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Heavy Mounted Units or Tanks can destroy them easily under most circumstances. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use Siege Units to bombard enemy fortified Infantry Units.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Garrison [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Guerrilla [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Medic [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannon Fodder
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can fortify by clicking the "Fortify" button or pressing "F". It will +50% [ICON_STRENGTH]Combat Strength when defending at the beginning of the next turn. When it moves, it will lose its fortification.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Workers can transfer to Militia anytime [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cheap training cost and maintenance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Receive Combat Bonus inside Friendly Territory [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Receive less casualties if destroyed [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can heal other units
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poorly trained, too weak to fight in the frontline against enemy regular army [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poor motility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Penalty outside Friendly Territory
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Transfer your first Warrior to a Worker, if there are available resources nearby, to speed up the development of your first city. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you are embroiled in an unexpected war, or attacked by barbarians, but you have no or few military units. Transfer your Workers to Militia Units to buy you some time. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bring some Militia Units with "Military Reserve" promotion to frontline during an invasion to serve as medical troops. What's more, they are competent cannon fodder to waste enemy firepower.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They cannot defeat your professional army in a fair fight. If outnumbered, call artillery or air-ground support like in the real life. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use Special Forces or Hit-and-run units to deal with them by their great combat bonus or mobility.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Core [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Multipurpose [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Durable
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]When it inflicts more damage to the enemy than it receives, forces the enemy unit to withdraw. (If the enemy unit can't withdraw, it will receive additional damage.)
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strong Combat Strength [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Versatile [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Durable and heals quiclky
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannot attack units on land [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No escaping abilities
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you are building up an navy, but don't know which unit you should choose, build a Naval Melee Unit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Naval Melee Units are competent for both aggressive and defensive missions, which makes them the main force (but not the flagships) of your navy. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always stay in groups for flanking bonus. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They can move after attacking and very useful for capturing enemy coastal cities. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Early Naval Melee Units are very powerful for a rush strategy since early cities are quite vulnerable. Two Trireme can take down an enemy coastal Capital in two turns in Ancient Era. However, the cost of a Trireme almost equals an ancient World Wonder. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Naval Ranged Units and Cruisers have great combat bonus against them. In most cases, them can be destroyed in one or two hit by melee attacks. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Although Naval Hit-and-run units are weak against them, but you can use wolfpack strategy to paralyze them by "Suppression" effects. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Destroyers have limited firepower against Fighters and Carrier-based Aircraft. Use "Air Sweep" ability to damage or destroy them to clear a path for your air strike if your land units cannot reach them.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Ganker [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Recon [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Disabler [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Counter
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The default "Right Click" will order the unit to perform a ranged attack. If you want it to perform a melee attack, click the "Attack" button on the left or press "A" key and click on the enemy unit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If it successfully put the debuff an enemy unit or your unit gets a debuff by the enemy attack. You will hear a special sound effect and get a notice on the right side of the screen.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Good price to performance [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Good at wolfpack
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Weak in defending itself [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]No escaping abilities
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are the cheapest regular Naval Units. So build more for reconnaissance and wolfpack strategy. Also don't be afraid of losing one of them. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are support units so they cannot serve as the main force. However they can still work in group as a tactical team away of your navy like Land Hit-and-run units. Use them to ambush enemy flagships or pillage enemy cargo ships. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Early Naval Hit-and-run Units can use their ranged attack against enemy units in coastal areas or harass enemy coastal cities. While Submarines have longer initial shooting range but lose the ability to attack land units or cities. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Escort your larger navy ships with enough Naval Melee Units. Naval Melee Units can destroy those small vessels in all cases with one hit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always keep a neat formation to leave no gaps for enemy Naval Hit-and-run Units to slip in. It is very troublesome to have your flagships ambushed during expedition. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Although Naval Hit-and-run Units cannot capture your cities, they can cause catastrophic result by pillaging all your improvements on water plots and block your coastal cities. Place some naval militia units to guard your coastline.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nuker [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strategic Weapon [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Game Ender [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Deterrence
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It works the same way as an land-based aircraft and can be based in a player-owned city or loaded on a SSBN. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]All strategic nuclear weapons have the same blast radius of 2 hexes.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Great Deterrence [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannot be Intercepted [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Global strikes capable
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Create Fallout [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]May cause [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Nuclear Winter[ENDCOLOR] which will make the planet uninhabitable
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Atomic Bomb is the first strategic nuclear weapon but it is less effective and cannot destroy cities,it can be upgraded to the nuclear missile in the information era, which has much longer attacking range, and it is more powerful to destroy cities with a population less than 6. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The ultimate weapon in SuperPower Mod is ICBM. It can wipe out any non-capital cities or reduce the population of capital city to 1. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If there are too many nuclear explosions in the planet (the number of plots covered with fallout reaches 1% of the whole map, including the water plots). The nuclear winter will fall, which cause all tiles with Food Output larger than 3 will reduce by 1 until it reaches 3. If more nuclear explosions occur, the nuclear winter will deteriorate. If the the number of plots covered with fallout reaches 10% of the map, all tiles' Food and Production output will reduce to 0 and the planet will be uninhabitable. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Once the nuclear winter is triggered, it cannot be stopped. But if no more nuclear explosions occur, [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nuclear explosions in water areas will not create fallout, thus it won't speed up the nuclear winter, it won't deteriorate. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]There is no way to intercept a strategic nuclear weapon. You must destroy them before launching. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The resolution of Nuclear Non-Proliferation can be unlocked earlier (Available once any nation discovers Nuclear Fusion) which means you can stop the global nuclear war before everyone has the ability. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can build Bomb Shelters in you main cities to minimize the citizen casualty, but it cannot prevent building loss. Unfortunately Bomb Shelters will consume additional electricity and expensive maintenance cost. This is another way how it impact the opponent's economy as strategic weapons.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Recon [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Support
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Caravels and Explorers are able to enter other nations' territory even without an Open Border Agreement. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A Caravel can "disembark" to transfer into an Explorer if next to a land plot. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]It moves stealthily but it still can be seen if get next to an enemy unit.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Stealth and Anti-stealth [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Excellent sight
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very Weak [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cannot pillage
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They can help you to explore the map to offer important intel. Do not forget to train them in early-game. In most cases, the whole map should be fully discovered before you entering the modern era. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Use Explorer's "Sell Exotic Goods" ability to earn some fast cash inside other civilizations' or city-states' territories. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If you have available Caravels and Explorers, send them into your future enemy territory to gather intels for your planned invasion. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are not aggressive units and cannot pillage. Do not worry about them.

[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Role:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Initiator [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Disabler [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Pusher [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]City Attacker
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]Operation:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]As long as other friendly units can see the target and it is within the attacking range, it is attackable. Even this unit cannot see the target. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]If it successfully put the debuff an enemy unit or your unit gets a debuff by the enemy attack. You will hear a special sound effect and get a notice on the right side of the screen.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pros:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Long firing range [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Strong attacking Cities, Citadel Units, Archery Units and Anti-air Units [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can break a deadlock in a battle [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can weaken enemy units
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Cons:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Expensive [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Poor mobility [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Very weak in defending itself [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Must work with escort units
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]In SuperPower Mod, cities have less initial HPs but their HPs regain faster. Cities with a larger population size will have much more HPs. As a result, Siege Unit is vital for attacking a big city. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Siege Units have great combat bonus attacking enemy fortified units, Archery Units and Anti-air Units, which makes it capable of destroying enemy defensive formations to break the deadlock. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Siege Units with "Collateral Damage" promotions can also be used to "suppress" the enemy by to weaken their attacks in the next turn. This is very helpful if you are outnumbered. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Always work with Hit-and-run Units with "Scouting" promotions to have the best effect. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Special Forces Units can offer "Target Guide" for this unit to boost its damage. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Experienced Siege Unit are high value units and should never go out alone. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_MAGENTA]Counter Tactics:[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]They are very weak in melee combat, which means any melee units in the same era can easily kill them in one hit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Cancel the fortification of your Infantry Units or Counter Units by moving them back and forth, also separate stacked units, if enemy Siege Units' bombardment is unavoidable. Fortified units and stacked units will suffer much more damage during Siege Units' bombardment and may be killed in one hit. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Although they cannot capture your city, your citizens in the city will be killed by their ranged attacks once the city HP is 0. So get rid of them ASAP!

SCENARIO DESCRIPTION[NEWLINE]Greetings to you, renowned Captain of science and industry! The advent of steam power has revolutionized the world. It is a time of discovery, fueled by newfound resources and brilliant inventions. Great airships trek across the skies, marking their trails with black smoke. Civilizations are propelled towards a bright future, but competition is fierce. Resources are scarce, and technological secrets are carefully guarded. You and your rivals must expand your empires across the globe to meet growing needs in the name of progress. Can you harness the power of steam technology and bring your people to greatness?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]VICTORY CONDITIONS[NEWLINE]Empires compete in the domains of Military, Culture, Industry, Commerce, and Labor. Be the best in a domain to earn an Honourable Title. To see the specifics of each Title, and monitor your progress, check the League of Empires screen. The first empire to hold three or more Titles wins the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]SPECIAL RULES[NEWLINE]Players begin with all technologies up through Steam Power. The tech tree after Steam Power has been altered significantly, giving players the ability to construct Airships, Landships, and new buildings. Barbarians ("Luddites") are enabled, but do not have access to advanced units. Social Policies have been rearranged. Religion has been disabled, as have religious and militaristic city-states.

The exact origins of Pulias are shrouded in mystery even to this day. It seems to have emerged out of nowhere, yet its power and wealth seem too large to have been easily missed. Most sources posit a single leader who saw the opportunities of new science, commerce, and most of all politics, and manipulated affairs from the shadows. This leader sold sensitive information to rivals at a premium while using it to further the objectives of Pulias. In the early competition between empires, many opportunities were left unexplored as rivals focused on short-term gains. Pulias was the first to send expeditions to foreign lands, and established trade that brought riches to its citizens. Its spies were placed in key positions across the world, gathering intelligence and ready to act.

Dalmace arose out of necessity. The turmoil of old kingdoms collapsing and new empires emerging left many people of the lower and middle classes marginalized. Some stayed in their homelands but many fled as refugees, not knowing where to go. They gathered in the country estates of nobles that did not have the heart or the force to deny their presence. Soon leaders arose from the ranks of the refugees, calling for organization, protection, food, and resources. Some nobles saw opportunity and joined their ranks, sharing their wealth. Others refused, and their estates were ransacked. These were the first Dalmace compounds, which would grow into cities that rivaled those of any other empire. Dalmace is founded on ideals, and its strength comes from the tight camaraderie and evolving culture of its humble citizens.

The Eruch Empire began as a series of impassioned debates between long established noble families about the growing chaos in the world and what could be done to stop it. The debates soon reached a critical mass for action, fueled by the nobles' fear of an uncertain future as well as their desire to protect their wealth. A secret council was formed, drawing on the leadership and military prowess that had been their inheritance from previous generations. It mobilized a small but well-equipped army. With it, the nobles carved out a large territory that would become the core of Eruch, and seceded from the old kingdoms. Outwardly, leaders of Eruch profess the glories of civilized life, and seek to spread their ways to the ends of the earth. They act as gentlemen in diplomatic affairs, but always have a rigid structure of military might ready to respond at their first call.

The steady advance of science brought great changes to the processes by which products were manufactured, transported, and sold. Many otherwise shrewd businessmen could not contend with the changes and faded away, leaving room for the more adaptable. Orlin had no political existence when it began, and no desire for empire. It was a collection of ambitious industrialists that banded together for mutual benefit. They parcelled out markets like territories, and together came to dominate industries throughout the old kingdoms. When the kingdoms began to fade, the Orlin tycoons clashed in a contest for power. They encroached on each other's ventures, and delved into blackmail and assassination. A tight oligarchy emerged which controlled nearly all the means of production. With their industrial capacity, and the riches it brought, they formally entered the world stage as an empire.

When the old kingdoms weakened, the growing class of academics and inventors saw the opportunity to create a new kind of nation, one that was founded on principles of reason and embraced scientific advancement. They found allies in many of the old monarchists, who were looking for a way to preserve their influence, and together they became Vedria. Their ranks mixed quickly, and before long every prominent leader was expected to be familiar with scientific processes, if not involved in research personally. Vedria is marked by optimism for the future to come, and its citizens believe that the noble pursuit of science is the clear path towards it. Scientists are consulted on matters of state, and given generous funding for their research.

The advent of steam power has revolutionized the world. It is a time of discovery, fueled by newfound resources and brilliant inventions. Can you harness the power of steam to bring your people to greatness?
I shall relish this game of war with you, and then our airships will cast your land into shadow.
I bow to you, sir, as you have proved to be my match. Enjoy your victory.
Ah, salutations. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Cyrus Rotheram of Eruch, known for our great military might. I hope you to be a valuable ally, or I shall judge you a worthy foe.

"The military sciences are as complex as ever, yet we have more tools at our disposal than ever before. Not a century ago, quelling the forces of a distant enemy required extensive fortifications, supply routes, and resources. Horses had to be fed and quartered, and the loss of a supply line could mean the end of an otherwise honorable campaign. Soldiers had to learn how to stare their enemy in the eye as they calmly readied their weapons and took life. In our present age, soldiers can face each other in honorable combat while avoiding the savageries of the previous century. The recent development of the Landship has made foot soldiers and cavalry all but obsolete. Limited only by the resources needed to build it, the Landship can traverse a nation in a matter of days without need of rest. Distant territories, once costly to conquer, are now within reach. And with its cannons and near impenetrable armor, the Landship can easily make pliant all but the most savagely persistent of the uncivilized nations."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] - Cyrus Rotheram, address to the Eruch Senate
Our factories have long prepared for this moment. You stand no chance against the progress of industry!
You, sir, are a villain. Go ahead, take our factories, but the world shall never know the greatness of industry in your hands.
Behold the greatest cog in the industrial machine, the nation of Orlin! I am Ignace Curnow, and shall warn you, sir, that any foolery shall be dealt with severely. My time is of great value.

"With the press of a button the steam jet enters the rig and begins the fabrication. Gears turning in the rig, pressing hot steel, shaping it into newly minted gears. A factory for making a factory. Maybe we will use it to make even more products; or maybe we will sell it to someone else for a wide profit. In this simple process is the proof of industry's role in our age. We can make airships, landships, difference engines, clothing, and even factories. By controlling the efficiency and maximizing the output of our industrial sector, we can make whatever we want, and be the best at it."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] - Ignace Curnow, excerpt from "Steel and Steam: An Industrialist's Guide"
This will be quick, I assure you. Be at peace in the knowledge that your defeat will help Pulias grow stronger.
I bow to you, sir, for your strong victory. My nation may have risen quietly, but the world knows that we did not go down in the same fashion.
Come, my good man, and let us talk a while. My name is Octavius Cutler of Pulias, perhaps you have heard of me? No matter. Pray tell me about yourself and your great accomplishments.

"There are those who say that power comes from science, and research is the way to more of it. Others find power in inventing new military contraptions, rolling around with their Landships and locking away stores of resources. But the true power is in none of these things. It is in the people that make these things. If we know what they know, then we have what they have. Let them fight amongst themselves and strive towards new discoveries. We make it our business to match their every step from the shadows, and our collected power becomes greater than all of theirs. If we do it right - and we must - they won't even notice."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] - Octavius Cutler, personal correspondence with newly appointed Intelligence Director
The music of our machines is upon your doorstep. I'll be sure to preserve what I can of your cities so that I may learn from your methods.
Well met, sir. I hope that you continue the pursuit of knowledge and invention in my absence.
I say, it is a pleasure to meet you! I am Luther Griggs, inventor extraordinaire, leader of Vedria! Let us share our knowledge in the spirit of science and friendship.

"Technological progress has brought marvels of mechanical achievement into our everyday life and allowed us to live in class and comfort. The whirring of the difference engines, the clack of brass gears, the steady burst of steam exhaust like the breath of a bull about to charge; these bring order into our world and allow us to perform marvels of science and computation that not only explain the natural world, but bring our order to bear firmly upon its sturdy shoulders. Airships have lifted our leaden bodies, once eternally bound to the earth, for sorties in the skies. With the sharp force of mind we have made real the eternal human dream of flight. And not with wings that the whims of natural selection deemed to give us, but with wings wrought from the sweat of our own brow and the fire of our own forge."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] - Luther Griggs, excerpt from "The Wings of Intellect"
Greetings, good sir! You appear to be an honourable gentleman. May our dealings long be amicable, and if we should meet on the battlefield may the best man win.
Ho, sir! I beg that you will state your business. Undoubtedly, your intentions are most admirable, else I shall warn you that I am quite a formidable foe.
My dear fellow, I must apologize for this act of aggression. Unfortunately there is no alternative.
Good gracious, this injustice is uncalled for! Dalmace may be gone in name, but it will live on through the common man.
Splendid meeting you, sir, simply splendid! Welcome to humble Dalmace. My name is Clinton Alderdice, and I happily offer you my hand in friendship.

"Of this above all do I pray you remember, Mr. Secretary. The Age of Steam has improved the livelihood of our great powers, but it has done so at the cost of the common man. The swath of achievements in the past decades has only made more clear what has been the black mark on human history: the powerful few exploit the powerless many. We have dismissed their difficulties as petty squabble, and appealed to our gentlemanly demeanor and productive enterprises as justification for our power, but the reality is that conditions are improving for us while they get worse for the common man. Left unchecked, this gap will continue to grow until the common man is no more than a serf. If I cannot appeal to you and the League on moral grounds - as it so seems, for I have tried tirelessly - let me warn you that our great society is becoming more and more unstable. The common man may not be as educated or refined as we, but he has eyes and ears and a mind, and he will not be able to ignore the decadence of our lifestyle. He will compare it to his own, and he will conspire with his neighbor. Together they will grow and form a disgruntled block, and before the century is out we will have an uncontrollable rebellion on our hands. And no amount of difference engine calculations or airship bombardments will be able to stop it, because those are built on the labor of those who have turned against us."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] - Clinton Alderdice, letter to the Grand Secretary of the League of Empires

Aetherium was first discovered by expedition parties who mistook it for silver. As their mining operations expanded, the flakes and chunks of it were gathered into large parcels for shipment, and something very strange happened. The parcels began to levitate off the ground. Scientists began to analyze this material's unusual properties. When masses of it are gathered together, it has the power to counteract gravity. With careful engineering, these counter-gravitational forces can be guided into a reliable source of lift, allowing ships to float in the sky. Its importance in the affairs of empire continues to grow, yet even today its properties are not well understood. One careless inventor's apparatus electrified a small chunk of aetherium, causing it to shoot upwards and punch a hole through the roof. The sample, engraved with the inventor's marking for experimental verification, was found weeks later, miles away from where it launched.

Appearing in the natural world as a nondescript, dull green ore, luboric glows under high temperatures. It is much more powerful and volatile than its predecessor, coal, and acts as the ultimate energy source for factories and vehicles alike. The chain of reactions and mechanisms required to utilize luboric are complex and unprecedented in the science of energies. Whereas most fuel sources yield their energy when burned, luboric is unfazed by flame, its green glow the only apparent reaction. To unlock the enormous potential present within chunks of luboric ore, it must be submerged in a solution of enzymes and subjected to both heat and pressure. The key reaction is not combustion, but dissolution. Its toxic gaseous exhaust must be carefully guided; if the fumes get trapped in a valve or corner for more than a few seconds it will eat through metal. Only with precautions will its legendary energy be loosed from its chemical bonds.

Acoustics is the study of sound. Sounds are waves of energy transmitted through gases, liquids and solids. The most important aspect of acoustics of course is that humans can "hear" sounds, and much of the current research involves improving human reception of sounds, especially for the deaf. Acoustics is used in other applications as well, including sonar. Sonar allows equipment to "hear" undersea vessels, animals and geological formations.[NEWLINE]Since acoustics require a medium in which the waves of energy can be transmitted, sound does not travel in the vacuum outside of Earth's atmosphere. It is a creepy but true statement that, "in space, no one can hear you scream."
Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Opera House[ENDCOLOR], which provides a large boost to [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.
[NEWLINE][TAB][TAB]"Their rising all at once was as the sound of thunder heard remote."[NEWLINE][TAB][TAB] - Milton
Management in businesses and organizations is the function that coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives by using available resources efficiently and effectively.
“When one with honeyed words but evil mind. Persuades the mob, great woes befall the state.” [NEWLINE] ― Euripides, Orestes

Ballistics is the science of shooting or throwing stuff great distances with great precision. Advanced ballistics is more of the same, with the distances increased to continent-spanning scale. Modern artillerists can shoot explosive rounds dozens of miles with great accuracy, and missiles can be fired at precise targets half-way around the planet. When embellishments like GPS and laser guidance are included, there is virtually no target anywhere in the world that can't be hit by some weapon somewhere. Whether this is a good thing is open to debate; it largely depends upon whose finger is on the firing button.

Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Nuclear Missile[ENDCOLOR], a frightening weapon that requires [ICON_RES_URANIUM] Uranium, and is capable of destroying units and cities. Also allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Guided Missile[ENDCOLOR], an inexpensive single-use Unit that can damage enemy Units, and the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]SS Booster[ENDCOLOR], one of the Spaceship parts necessary to win a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Science Victory[ENDCOLOR].
[NEWLINE][TAB][TAB]"Our scientific power has outrun our spiritual power. We have guided missiles and misguided men."[NEWLINE] - Martin Luther King, Jr.[NEWLINE][TAB]

Aeronautical Engineering deals with aircraft design while Aerospace Engineering is a more modern term that expands the reach envelope of the discipline by including spacecraft design. Its origins can be traced back to the aviation pioneers around the turn of the century from the 19th century to the 20th although the work of Sir George Cayley has recently been dated as being from the last decade of the 18th century. Early knowledge of aeronautical engineering was largely empirical with some concepts and skills imported from other branches of engineering. Only a decade after the successful flights by the Wright brothers, the 1920s saw extensive development of aeronautical engineering through development of World War I military aircraft. Meanwhile, research to provide fundamental background science continued by combining theoretical physics with experiments.

Researching this new technology will unlock new buildings, wonders, units and elite units. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tile Improvement[ENDCOLOR] construction speed increased by 25%. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Allows [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Workers[ENDCOLOR] to move across the mountain or the ice.
“One man's magic is another man's engineering. Supernatural is a null word.” [NEWLINE] ― Robert A. Heinlein

Little did the Wright Brothers know that less than four decades after their first plane touched down in the North Carolinian sand, aeronautical engineers would have already created a completely new way to power flight - the jet engine. The jet engine would find further application in the creation of the helicopter.
"Oh! I have slipped the surly bonds of Earth, put out my hand and touched the face of God! " [NEWLINE] - John Gillespie Magee
What role does technology play in civilization?

Agriculture is the production of plants and animals, most notably for food, but also for clothing, shelter, medicine, recreation, and other diverse uses. Crop cultivation probably developed independently in numerous places. The earliest evidence of agriculture thus far discovered dates back to the end of the last ice age, approximately 11,000 years ago. Interestingly, it appears that agriculture was not invented by starving hunter-gatherers desperately seeking new sources of sustenance; instead, evidence suggests that the earliest agriculturalists were successful and wealthy hunter-gatherers who probably had plenty of food already on hand. This makes some sense: people with a surplus of food can afford to experiment on new technologies, while those who are hungry are going to expend all of their energy on tried and true methods of gaining sustenance.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In its infancy, agriculture was a slow, cyclical process. Seeds were sown in the spring, the fields were tended and watered until the crops were ready to be harvested, often many months later. Since very few places have climates suitable for year-round agricultural production, farmers had to be able to store food for the lean winter months or they had to trade with those who could gather food year-round from hunting, fishing, and so forth. Farmers have always been at the mercy of nature and the weather: if it didn't rain one year or pests ate the crop, a family might simply starve.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Modern agriculture (or "agribusiness") is a complicated and exacting science of genetic manipulation, advanced fertilizer and insecticides, and computerized irrigation systems and robotic harvesters. Advances in the technology have greatly increased the output of food from a given acre of soil, so much so that some countries - including the United States - occasionally suffer not from famine, but from a glut of food, resulting in chronic obesity in their citizenry and prices so cheap as to threaten the livelihood of the very farmers who are growing all the food.
Allows Workers to construct [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Farms[ENDCOLOR], vital for increasing the [ICON_FOOD] [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Food[ENDCOLOR] output of map tiles.
[NEWLINE][TAB][TAB]"Where tillage begins, other arts follow. The farmers therefore are the founders of human civilization."[NEWLINE][TAB][TAB] - Daniel Webster[NEWLINE][TAB]
How can ancient ruins help research?
Some ancient ruins will give you new technology. This is not guaranteed, but it's another good reason to search them out and claim them before anybody else does.

Animal husbandry appears to have occurred at about the same time as the invention of agriculture. The dog appears to be the earliest domesticated animal, probably bred to assist in hunting and killing game. Evidence suggests that they were first tamed and bred in China - in fact, geneticists believe that about 95% of the dogs living today are descended from just a few common Chinese animals. Goats and sheep were domesticated in the Middle East perhaps by about 10,000 BC.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]To be successfully domesticated, an animal must fit certain criteria: it should be able to consume food that is less attractive to humans, say, grass or vermin or leftover table scraps. It should mature rapidly, so that it becomes useful quickly and so that it can be genetically altered through repeated generations of breeding. It should have a pleasant disposition. It shouldn't panic easily, or if it does, it should stay together with others of its kind, making it possible for humans or dogs to herd them in a group.
