Establishes sea-based Trade Routes between two civilizations that yields [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Can also be used to deliver [ICON_FOOD] Food or [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production within your own borders after building a Granary or a Workshop.
Initially carries 3 Aircraft; capacity may be boosted through promotions.

Powerful early game Mounted Unit. Weak to Spearmen. Only the Carthaginians may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Horseman which it replaces and strikes fear into nearby enemy units. Helps produce Great Generals more quickly.
Strong Ancient Era Naval Unit used to dominate the seas through melee attacks on naval units and cities. Only the Carthaginians may build it.
First siege Unit of the game. Does major damage to Units and Cities from a distance, but must set up prior to firing.
Mounted Unit capable of fighting toe-to-toe with contemporary infantry units.

Only the Celts may build this unit. It has a combat bonus outside of friendly territory and can pillage enemy improvements at no additional movement cost. Earns 50% of opponents' strength as [ICON_PEACE] Faith for kills.
A fast Ranged Unit highly effective on flat ground.
Elite Long Range Multiple Rocket Launcher. It has great mobility and huge combat bonus against naval units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Anti-ship MLRS Project and only three can exist in the world.
Medieval ranged infantry Unit. Only the Chinese may build it. This Unit may fire twice in one turn, unlike the Crossbowman which it replaces.
Can start a [ICON_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age. Only after adopting the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Church Artists[ENDCOLOR] Belief can you purchase it.

Fast and powerful early game Mounted Unit. Weak to Spearmen. Only the Greeks may build it. This Unit is faster, has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength and helps produce Great Generals more quickly than the Horseman which it replaces.
Elite mercenary militia unit. Can only be purchased in the city and can move after purchase. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Elite Militia Project. You can purchase as many as you want.
Cavalry that spawns Great Generals faster and fights better in open terrain. Only the Egyptians can build it.
Fast late game ship making it highly effective at recon. Also used to hunt down and destroy enemy Submarines. Fights as a naval melee unit.
+25% Combat Strength VS Wounded Units. +50% Combat Strength VS Armor Units. Gain -20 Unhappiness per Unit.
Egyptian unique early hit-and-run unit. Replaces the Chariot Archer. It is faster than the generic chariot and hitting the enemy with strong ranged attacks.
An extremely durable heavy armored battleship. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Heavy Armored Battle Ship Project and only one can exist in the world.
Elite Sniper Unit, move stealthily and can paradrop within 16 hexes. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Elite Sniper Training Project and only one can exist in the world.

A special archaeologist that is not slowed by rough terrain and has a weak attack and defense. Only the Europeans can build it. Does not require a University. [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Like all units in this scenario it does not have the Explore command.[ENDCOLOR]

[ICON_BULLET]An upgrade version of Scout. It can enter other nations' territory even without an Open Border Agreement. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The explorer can only be acquired by "disembarking" a Caravel. it cannot be trained in cities.
Air Unit designed to wrest control of the skies and intercept incoming enemy aircraft.
An infantry unit that specializes fighting in rough terrain and against wounded units. Only the Belgians can build it.

Special Infantry Unit of the Modern Era. May only be received through adopting the Volunteer Army tenet of the Freedom Ideology. This Unit has a combat bonus outside of friendly territory but is otherwise very similar to Great War Infantry.
Only the French may build it. This Unit has a combat bonus outside of friendly territory, unlike the Rifleman which it replaces.
Rifleman that specializes in defense and heals whenever it kills its oponent. Only the Boer Republics can build it.

Eurocopter EC665 Tigre is a carrier-based attack helicopter. It can be automatically resupplied on a Mistral-class Amphibious Assault Ship. It is more powerful and has a longer flight range than the guided missile. It will transfer EXPs earned in battle and inherit all promotions of its carrier like other carrier-based aircraft.

Strong, front-line land Unit, which can only be built by the Franks. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Swordsman, which it replaces. It starts with the Amphibious promotion.
Powerful Renaissance Era naval Unit used to wrest control of the seas.
Medieval Era Naval Unit used to wrest control of the seas with its ranged attack.
Gatling guns are part of your front-line troops for excellent fire support, being as useful against melee troops as infantry. However it is still weak when attacked.

Strong, front-line land Unit, which can only be built by the Goths. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Swordsman, which it replaces. It moves along enemy roads as if they were friendly roads.

Upgraded front-line Infantry Unit, stronger and faster than its previous version. Weak vs Landships and Machine Gun, however, it has the ability to build Fort in the battlefield to improve its survivability.
A cheap Unit that may be used once to damage enemy Units or Cities.

Can hack into your enemy national network and cause the whole country fall into anarchy for two turns. Must inside the target nation's territory to perform its action. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Bit Weapon Project and only one can exist in the world.
Advanced hovering fast-attack unit can cross mountain and water. It can also offer fire support for ground troops.
Ancient Era Unit which specializes in defeating Mounted Units. Only the Greeks may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Spearman which it replaces.
Fast and powerful early game Mounted Unit. Weak to Spearmen.
Siege unit deadly at melee attacks versus cities. Only the Huns may build it.
Unique Hunnic early hit-and-run unit. Replaces the Chariot Archer. It is stronger but cheaper than the generic chariot.
This Hun Great Person replaces the Great General. While providing the same combat bonus as a Great General, the Scourge of God also moves at a faster rate and heals adjacent units.

Ancient Era Unit which specializes in defeating Mounted Units. Only the Persians may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength and heals more quickly than the Spearman, which it replaces.
A fast Ranged Unit highly effective on flat ground. Only the Indians may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat and Ranged Strength than the Chariot Archer, which it replaces.
Classical Era Melee unit that has a mystical weapon whose abilities will be discovered the first time it is used in combat. May only be build by Indonesia.
Advanced front-line Infantry Unit, stronger than its previous version and can build Fort. Weak vs Tanks.
Used to remove other religions from cities. May only be obtained by purchasing with [ICON_PEACE] Faith.
A very powerful naval melee unit, the Ironclad pays for its strength by being slower in ocean tiles.
Fairly weak early-game military Unit. Only the Aztecs may build it. This Unit fights more effectively in Jungle and heals damage when it kills an enemy Unit, unlike the Warrior which it replaces.
One of the first gunpowder units of the game. Only the Ottomans may build it. This Unit is stronger on offense and heals when it kills an enemy, unlike the Musketman which it replaces.
Air Unit designed to wrest control of the skies and intercept incoming enemy aircraft.
Powerful Medieval Mounted Unit, weak to Pikemen.
Advanced Mounted Unit designed to be on the attack and break through enemy battle lines.
Elite mercenary unit. Can only be purchased in the city and can move after purchase. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Landsknecht Mercenary Project. You may purchase Landsknechts as many as you want.

Elite Archery Unit with longer shooting range, sundering ability and combat bonus against Heavy Mounted Units. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Longbowman Training Project and only one can exist in the world.
The Machine Gun is a ranged unit which is best against enemy infantry. Use it at the front line for additional firepower.
Atomic Era Unit especially useful for embarking and invading across the sea.
Only the Maya may build this unit. It is cheaper and available sooner than the Archer, which it replaces.

It is so tall that it can cross the mountains or walking in costal area. It is immune to strategic nuclear weapons' blasts and free from some debuff effects from the enemy like "sundered" and "slowed down". Can heal every turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Prototype Jager Project and only one can exist in the world.
The most advanced front-line Infantry Unit. Starts with Medic Promotion and can build Fort.
Strong, front-line land Unit that specializes in fighting in rough terrain and defending near the Ethiopian capital. Only the Ethiopians may build it.

One of the first gunpowder units of the game. Only the Americans may build it. Replaces the Musketman. This Unit may move through rough ground as though it were flat, receives a combat bonus when defending.
Advanced naval ranged unit of the Information Era, can be upgraded from Battleships. It can carry 3 Missiles and defend itself against attack from the air. However it is weak against submarines.
Used to spread a religion to cities. May only be obtained by purchasing with [ICON_PEACE] Faith.
Will intercept enemy aircraft which try to bomb nearby Units within 4 tiles. Its missile can also target enemy land units within 2 tiles. However it is less effective except vs helicopters.
Strong, front-line land Unit of the Classical Era. Only the Iroquois may build it. This Unit receives a major bonus when fighting on Forest and Jungle, unlike the Swordsman which it replaces.
One of the first gunpowder units of the game. Only the French may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Musketman, which it replaces.
First gunpowder Unit of the game. Fairly cheap and powerful.
Powerful Medieval Mounted Unit, weak to Pikemen. Only the Songhai may build it. This Unit is not penalized when attacking Cities, unlike the Knight which it replaces.
Excellent at exploring and fearsome in combat, this Shoshone Unique Unit replaces the Scout. It possesses a promotion that gives it [ICON_PEACE] Faith for discovering Natural Wonders.
Powerful Medieval Mounted Unit, weak to Pikemen. Possesses the Blitz promotion. Only the Normans may build it. Replaces the standard Knight.
A tactical nuclear artillery can cause massive damage to enemy units in groups or kill citizens in a city. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Nuclear Artillery Project. Only one can exist in the world.

[ICON_BULLET]Advanced nuclear weapon.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can damage enemy City and destroy Improvements and Units within the range of 2 tiles. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can destroy enemy city which Population is less than 5. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Consumes 3 Air Unit Capacity in a city.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can be loaded on [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]SSBNs[ENDCOLOR].
Invisible to all Units except Destroyers, Missile Cruisers and other Submarines, or until it attacks or is adjacent to another unit. Can carry 2 Missiles, and is specialized in attacking Naval Units.

Elite hit-and-run unit. Can perform both melee attacks and ranged attacks. Can gain additional [ICON_MOVES] Movement by switching to "Rapid March" mode. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Numidian Cavalry Training Project and only one can exist in the world.
Orbital Drop Shock Troopers are the ultimate war fighters, having served on multiple frontiers on Earth and Space. Use carefully, as they are very expensive to maintain.

A superweapon for global bombardment. Once the tungsten rods launched, every enemy city's HP will immediately drop to 0. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If the controller unit is destroyed, this weapon system is disabled.
The most advanced multirole fighter unit. Can attack land and naval units. Also equipped with EMP Missiles[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires PAK FA Project and only one can exist in the world.
Fast and powerful late game Unit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Only the Germans may build it. This Unit has 1 additional movement compared to the Tank, which it replaces.
Strong infantry Unit capable of paradropping up to 9 tiles from friendly territory. Paratrooper can also move and pillage after paradropping, but cannot enter combat until the following turn.

Its proton collider gun will cause "butterfly effects", one shot will do damage to every visible enemy unit on the map. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Particle Weapon Development Project and only one can exist in the world.
Specialized in defeating Knights and other mounted Units.

Portuguese Special Unit. Replace the Caravel. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Unique Abilities[ENDCOLOR]: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can perform a one-time ability next to foreign lands to earn [ICON_GOLD] Gold and XP. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_MOVES] Movement. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Does [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]NOT[ENDCOLOR] require the Naval Exploration Project.
Naval Unit that specializes in attacking coastal cities to earn gold and capturing enemy ships.

An experimental prototype stealth bomber. Apart from its long air-range, it has a chance of 50% to evade enemy fighter's interception. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It cannot be deployed on Carriers.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Prototype Stealth Bomber Project and only one can exist in the world.
You are right, it is a real submarine and can move underwater. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Prototype Submarine Project and only one can exist in the world.
Siege unit between Cannon and Artillery.
Strong, front-line land Unit of the mid-game.
Multiple Launch Rocket System is an updated rocket artillery unit which has better mobility.
Strong, front-line land Unit of the Classical Era. Only the Romans may build it. This Unit has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Swordsman, which it replaces.
Unique unit of the Japanese civilization. Strong vs Cities and fortified units. Replaces the Longswordsman.
Powerful Medieval Melee Unit, strong against Mounted and Ranged Units. Possesses the Cover I and Bonus vs. Mounted (50) promotions. Only the English may build it. Replaces the Longswordsman.
Excellent at exploring, this Unit is not slowed by rough terrain, but is vulnerable to attack.
Naval Unit that specializes in attacking coastal cities to earn gold and capturing enemy ships. Only the Dutch can build it.

Founds new Cities or join your existing Cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settlers cannot be purchased and training it will consume one [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen in the current city, but [ICON_FOOD] Growth of the City will NOT stop. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settler takes [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]damage[ENDCOLOR] if ends turn in outside friendly territory. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If a Settler is captured by enemy combat units, it will be KILLED.
Powerful Renaissance Era Naval Unit used to wrest control of the seas. Only the English may build it.
Mounted unit that specializes in quick attacks. May only be built by the Shoshone.
Excellent at exploring and fearsome in combat, this Shoshone Unique Unit replaces the Scout. It possesses a promotion that allows it to choose the benefit when uncovering an ancient ruin.

Powerful Medieval Mounted Unit, weak to Pikemen. Only the Siamese may build it. This Unit receives a bonus against other mounted Units and has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Knight, which it replaces.
Mounted Unit specialized in defeating enemy Mounted Units. May only be built by the Ottomans. This Unit is faster and can see further than the Lancer, which it replaces.
La Armada Invincible is a heavy combat vessel that can also be used to gain some gold upon defeat enemy naval units. Only the Spanish civilization can build it.
Elite infantry unit. Extremely strong when defending. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Spartiates Training Project and only one can exist in the world.
Ancient Era Unit which specializes in defeating Mounted Units.
Provides global combat bonus for all aircraft you own. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Project Habu and only one can exist in the world.

One of the Spaceship parts that must be built and sent to the capital to win a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Science Victory[ENDCOLOR]. Unlike other parts, three SS Boosters are needed to complete the spaceship.
One of the Spaceship parts that must be built and sent to the capital to win a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Science Victory[ENDCOLOR].
Advanced Strategic Bomber for attacking Cities. Can kill population or destroy buildings in enemy City. This unit consumes 4 Air Unit Capacity in your City and cannot be deployed on Carriers.

Invisible to all Units except Destroyers, Missile Cruisers and other Submarines, or until it attacks or is adjacent to another unit. Can cause major damage to other ships if they get into range without being seen.

A super battleship which is is almost invincible in the sea. It can be set to "Full Attack" mode to double the firepower and +1 range at a sacrifice of mobility. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Super Battleship Project and only one can exist in the world.
A heavy armored tank armed with devastating 128 mm gun. It is almost invincible on the ground. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Super-heavy Tank Project and only one can exist in the world.
Strong, front-line land Unit that specializes in long marches, even far from Swedish lands. Only the Swedish may build it.
Elite mounted Unit that specializes in working with Great Generals. Only the Swedish may build it.
Strong, front-line land Unit of the Classical Era.
Fast and powerful late game Unit.

The Elite Special Forces Unit whic start with all Special Forces Unit's Promotions. Can use air EVAC to return to your Capital at any time from anywhere. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Task Force 141 Project and only one can exist in the world.
Powerful Medieval Siege Unit, good at reducing the defenses of enemy Cities. Must set up prior to firing.
Early Air Unit designed to intercept incoming enemy aircraft.
Ancient Era Naval Unit used to wrest control of the seas through melee attacks on naval units and cities.
An ultimate nuclear bomb which can destroy non-capital cities in one hit. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires the Manhattan Project and Trutnev-Babaev Project. Only one can exist in the world.

Strong, front-line land Unit, which can only be built by the Vandals. It has a higher [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength than the Swordsman, which it replaces. It starts with the Charge promotion, giving it a combat bonus against damaged units.
Strong Naval Unit used to dominate the seas through melee attacks on naval units and cities. Can capture enemy ships. Only the Vandals may build it.

A brutally powerful Medieval Era Naval Unit used to wrest control of the seas with its ranged attack. Better at attacking and defending than the normal Galleass it replaces, but more expensive. May only be built by Venice.

This Venetian unique Great Person replaces the Great Merchant. Aside from the ability to Conduct a Trade Mission, the Merchant of Venice can purchase City-States outright, bringing them under Venetian control as a Puppet.

Medieval ranged infantry Unit. Only the Celts may build it. This Unit has 1 additional range compared to the Crossbowman, but is slightly weaker. This Unit may move through rough ground as though it were flat.

Heavy Mounted Unit specialized in defeating enemy mounted units. This unit is faster and more powerful than the Lancer, which it replaces. Forces defenders to retreat when it inflicts more damage than it receives. May only be built by the Polish.
Creates Improvements on water resources like [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish. The Work Boat is consumed in the process. It is defenseless, and will be killed if it comes into contact with an enemy.

Improves [ICON_FOOD] Food [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and [ICON_GOLD] Gold by constructing Improvements on map tiles outside of Cities, both on land on on water tiles. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If a Worker or Settler is captured by enemy combat units, it will be KILLED. Yeah, you humans are so uncivilized to take AI's workers for free.
Early Air Unit that can bombard enemy Units and Cities from the skies.
The first of its kind, this powerful late game unit can move after attacking.

Futuristic infantry unit skilled at dropping into danger from far across the world. Squad can move and pillage after landing but cannot enter combat until the following turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_CYAN]Good Luck, Commander![ENDCOLOR]
A multi-purpose Attacking Aircraft. Only the Japanese may build it. This Unit can not only attack land or naval units but also can perform an air sweep to take down enemy intercepting fighters.

This treasure fleet can conduct a trade mission in a City-State. Also, its combat strength can match any naval units in this era. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Treasure Voyages Project and only three can exist in the world at one time. This unit CANNOT upgrade.
Specialized in defeating Knights and other mounted units. Only the Zulu may build it. Also performs a first-strike ranged attack before combat.
Powerful Ancient Melee Unit, strong in open terrain. Possesses the Shock I promotion. Only the Hittites may build it. Replaces the Chariot Archer.

The Heavy Chariot is the Hittite unique unit, replacing the Chariot Archer. Unlike the Chariot Archer, the Heavy Chariot is a melee attack unit specializing in charging and breaking enemy fronts. This unit starts with the Shock I promotion.

The Horseman is the first really powerful cavalry unit, combining speed with a powerful melee attack. The Horseman can move after attacking. As a mounted unit, the Horseman remains vulnerable to attacks from Spearmen, Pikemen and the like.

A howitzer is a type of artillery piece characterized by a relatively short barrel and the use of comparatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles at relatively high trajectories, with a steep angle of descent. Until fairly recently, about the end of the Second World War, such weapons were characterized by a barrel length 15 to 25 times the caliber of the gun.

Battering Rams are a Hunnic unique unit replacing the Catapult. Use Battering Rams to knock down the defenses of a city. They have the Cover I promotion to keep them safe from ranged units; attack them with melee units to defeat them.

Horse Archers are fast ranged units, deadly on open terrain. They are slightly stronger in defense than the Chariot Archer and can move through rough terrain without the Chariot Archer's movement penalty. They also start with the Accuracy I promotion. As a mounted unit, the Horse Archer is vulnerable to Spearmen. Unlike the Chariot Archer, the Horse Archer does not require Horses.

The Scourge of God is a Hun Unique Great Person, replacing the standard Great General. The same combat bonuses apply, but the Scourge moves at a faster rate and can heal adjacent units for an additional 20 HP per turn. This enhanced General ensures that his cavalry units will always be in a battle-ready state.

Shaman is the unique unit of Hun, replacing the Inquisitor. It can be trained or be purchased with faith in cities. However it is not a religious unit and cannot remove other religions from cities. It can use mysterious sorcery to remove any debuffs of your units and make units around it healing +30HP per turn.

The word "shaman" probably originates from the Tungusic Evenki language of North Asia. According to ethnolinguist Juha Janhunen, "the word is attested in all of the Tungusic idioms" such as Negidal, Lamut, Udehe/Orochi, Nanai, Ilcha, Orok, Manchu and Ulcha, and "nothing seems to contradict the assumption that the meaning 'shaman' also derives from Proto-Tungusic" and may have roots that extend back in time at least two millennia.

[ICON_BULLET]The most powerful nuclear weapon in the game. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]One single ICBM can utterly destroy a non-capital city and everything within the range of 2 tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Consumes 3 Air Unit Capacity in a city.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Can be loaded on [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]SSBNs[ENDCOLOR].

The War Elephant is the Indian unique unit, replacing the Chariot Archer. It is more powerful (if slower) than the Chariot Archer and can move through any terrain without the Chariot Archer's penalty. A mounted unit, the War Elephant is quite vulnerable to the Spearman.
The Kris Swordsman replaces the standard Swordsman. Try him out in combat as soon as possible to unlock the secret properties of his curvy Kris blade.

Infantry is significantly stronger than its predecessor, the Great War Infantry. Modern combat is increasingly complex, and on its own an Infantry unit is vulnerable to air, artillery and tank attack. When possible Infantry should be supported by artillery, tanks, and air (or anti-air) units.

Can be purchased with [ICON_PEACE] Faith in any city with a majority Religion that has been enhanced. They can remove other religions from your cities (expending the Inquisitor) or be placed inside a city to protect it from Missionaries and Prophets trying to spread other religions into that city.

An interceptor aircraft, or simply interceptor, is a type of fighter aircraft designed specifically to prevent successful missions by enemy aircraft, particularly bombers and reconnaissance aircraft. There are generally two classes of interceptors, light aircraft built for outright performance, and heavier aircraft designed to fight at night or in heavy weather and operate over longer ranges.

Ironclads are the first steam-powered warships available. Fighting as a naval melee unit, they are harder to kill than any sailing vessel, and their Combat strength is higher. Use them primarily for in-shore defense and to assault cities.

The Mohawk Warrior is the Iroquoian unique unit, replacing the Swordsman. As powerful as the Swordsman in Clear or Hilly terrain, the Mohawk Warrior receives a significant combat bonus in Forest and Jungle. Also, unlike the Swordsman, it does not require Iron to build.

The Iroquoian soldiers were one of the most powerful and influential Indian nations. If their desperate efforts failed, they would all die -- either by musket and tomahawk in the burning villages, or by barbarous torture after capture.

With their victory in the Russo-Japanese War of 1904–05, the Japanese became concerned about the potential for conflict with the US. The theorist Satō Tetsutarō developed the doctrine that Japan should have a battlefleet at least 70% the size of that of the US. This would enable the Japanese navy to win two decisive battles, the first early in a war against the US Pacific Fleet, and the second against the US Atlantic Fleet which would inevitably be dispatched as reinforcements.

The Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN; Kyūjitai: 大日本帝國海軍 Shinjitai: 大日本帝国海軍 About this sound Dai-Nippon Teikoku Kaigun or 日本海軍 Nippon Kaigun, literally "Navy of the Greater Japanese Empire") was the navy of the Empire of Japan from 1868 until 1945, when it was dissolved following Japan's defeat and surrender in World War II.

The Samurai is the Japanese unique unit, replacing the Longswordsman. As powerful as the Swordsman, the Samurai is built with "Volley I" Promotion so it is powerful attacking enemy cities and fortified units. Success in combat with a Samurai has an increased chance of generating Great Generals.

The Zero is the Japanese unique Multi-Purpose Aircraft unit, replacing the Dive Bomber. With its "Anti-Fighter"Promotion, its air-sweep proves to be deadly for enemy intercepting fighters. What's more, with its anti-fighter ability, it can always survive and finish its mission even intercepted. It is always smart for Zeros to attack in groups - and it is very cheap for mass production. Use some Zero to shoot down enemy fighters while others can safely attack land or naval targets.
A strategic bomber is a mid-to-long range heavy bomber aircraft designed to drop large amounts of ordnance onto a distant target for the purposes of debilitating the enemy capacity to wage war.

The Jet Fighter is a powerful air unit. It can be based in any city you own or aboard an aircraft carrier. It can move from base to base and can perform "missions" within its range of "10". Use Jet Fighters to attack enemy aircraft and ground units, to scout enemy positions, and to defend against enemy air attacks. Jet Fighters are especially effective against enemy helicopters. The Jet Fighter has the "air recon" ability, which means that everything within 6 tiles of its starting location is visible at the beginning of the turn. See the rules on Aircraft for more information.
A devastating long-range attack unit which can attack with Area of Effects damage.

A multiple rocket launcher (MRL) is a type of unguided rocket artillery system. Like other rocket artillery, multiple rocket launchers are less accurate and have a much lower (sustained) rate of fire than batteries of traditional artillery guns. However, they have the capability of simultaneously dropping many hundreds of kilograms of explosive, with devastating effect..

The Kirov-class battlecruiser is a class of nuclear-powered warship of the Russian Navy, the largest and heaviest surface combatant warships (i.e. not an aircraft carrier or amphibious assault ship) in operation in the world. Among modern warships, they are second in size only to large aircraft carriers, and of similar size to a World War I-era battleship. The official designation of the ship-type is "heavy nuclear-powered guided missile cruiser" (Russian: тяжёлый атомный ракетный крейсер). The ships are often referred to as battlecruisers by western defense commentators due to their size and general appearance.

The Knight is a fast and powerful unit, the undisputed king of the medieval battlefield. As a mounted unit it is vulnerable to Pikemen, but it can crush other opponents with relative ease. The Knight can move after it attacks, allowing it to make holes in the enemy lines and then ride straight through them.

The Sejong the Great-class destroyers (Sejongdaewang-Ham or Hangul: 세종대왕급 구축함, Hanja: 世宗大王級驅逐艦), also known as KD-III, are guided missile destroyers of the Republic of Korea Navy (ROKN). The second ship was commissioned in August 2010. As of 2010, the ROKN has committed itself to deploy three ships with an option for three more.

The Lancer is the Renaissance horse unit that comes between the Knight and the Cavalry unit. It's faster and more powerful than the Knight, able to sweep those once-mighty units from the map. The Lancer can even take on the powerful Cavalry unit once it appears.
More powerful version of the Land Ironclad. Strong against other land units, but weak against airships.

The Landship is heavily armored and excels at ground combat. Use it to defeat other land units and wear down cities for capture. Its armor will help protect it against the smaller guns of Flyers, but it is vulnerable to cannon fire from Airships. Escort the Landship with units that are strong against air units, such as Flyers and Anti-Air Guns, for maximum survivability.

The Landship was everything the land ironclad was to be but was not. The discovery of luboric increased the energy available to power such a vehicle exponentially, allowing for more armor and weaponry while maintaining the same maneuverability. It became the gold standard on the battlefield, capable of destroying nearly any other land unit. With several of them, a commander could quickly take out an army or encircle a city.
An experimental steam-powered armored vehicle. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Prototype Tank Project. You can build or purchase as many as you want.

The Prototype Tank is a legendary steam-powered unit designed to break through enemy battle line. It is an Armored Unit so pikes cannot stop it for its heavy armor and machine gun so there is no way to stop this iron monster in its era. However, it will quickly become old-fashioned when landship is unlocked.

Much had been learned from the construction of the "Iron Horse" that was the railroad. Soon, inventors tried to engineer a vehicle with the power of a locomotive without need of a track. Designing the apparatus for moving the unwieldy metal beasts that were the first prototypes proved extremely difficult. The process merged into a simpler design with much less armor plating, but enough to withstand gunfire and the elements. The first drivers found that having a light, maneuverable craft was much more effective than a bulky one. It allowed for quick travel on less fuel, as well as agility in combat.
Most advanced landship unit. Strong against other land units, but weak against airships.

The Land Leviathan is the pinnacle of landship units, bringing devastation to any other land unit. Use it to destroy vulnerable enemy Anti-Air Guns and ensure your air units stay safe. Its armor will help protect it against the smaller guns of Flyers, but it is still vulnerable to cannon fire from Airships and Sky Fortresses. It is best to protect the expensive Land Leviathan with units that are strong against air units, such as Flyers and Anti-Air Guns.

The Land Leviathan is the pinnacle of ground combat. Taking its name from the fantastic sea monster, it boasts immense firepower. It can fire from almost any angle and trek across the land at great speeds. It is outfitted with a crew of sixteen: some man the cannons, others tend the luboric engine, and a pair act as pilot and navigator. During training they learn to move and think as one unit, developing a shorthand language for giving complex commands quickly.
An ironclad is a steam-propelled warship protected by iron or steel armor plates used in the early part of the second half of the 19th century.

The littoral combat ship (LCS) is a class of relatively small surface vessels intended for operations in the littoral zone (close to shore) by the United States Navy. It was "envisioned to be a networked, agile, stealthy surface combatant capable of defeating anti-access and asymmetric threats in the littorals."

The Longswordsman is the standard medieval infantry combat unit. It is more powerful than the Knight, but much slower. It also outclasses the Pikeman, but doesn't receive that unit's bonus versus mounted units. Use Longswordsmen and Catapults to attack enemy cities.

The Machine Gun is the penultimate non-siege ranged unit. It is more powerful than earlier ranged units. Like the Gatling Gun it has only a one-hex range, but still can deal significant damage to other units without being hurt itself. It is vulnerable to melee attack. Put Machine Guns in your city for defense.

A main battle tank (MBT), also known as a battle tank or universal tank, is a tank that fills the armor-protected direct fire and maneuver role of many modern armies. They were originally conceived to replace the light, medium, heavy and super-heavy tanks. Development was spurred in the Cold War with the development of lightweight composite armour. They are still supplemented in some armies with light tanks. Not all armored, tracked military vehicles are tanks and are designed for other battlefield roles.
The Marine is an alternative to Infantry. It costs a bit more than Infantry but possesses promotions that enhance its Sight and attack strength when embarked at sea.

The Atlatlist is the Mayan unique unit, replacing the Archer. Atlatlists are both cheaper than a traditional Archer, and available earlier without having to research Archery. This early game advantage allows other research priorities to come into play.
An early multi-role fighter, designed for mass production. Weaker than more advanced aircraft, but is much cheaper to produce and maintain.

The MiG-21 is a supersonic jet fighter designed by the Mikoyan-Gurevich Design Bureau in the Soviet Union during the early days of the Cold War. Known to the West as Fishbed, the MiG-21 quickly became a mainstay of Soviet-aligned air forces, having been used by around 60 countries, and still serves in some air forces. It is most produced supersonic jet aircraft in aviation history and the most-produced combat aircraft since the Korean War. It is capable of flying about twice the speed of sound, has around 32 variants, and was involved in the Indo-Pakistani war of 1971, the Vietnam war, the Yom Kippur war, the Syrian civil warm and the Iran-Iraq war. During the American Cold War incursions into Iron Curtain dominated airspace, a Soviet Air Defence Forces MiG-21 intercepted and shot down a US Air Force RB-66 Destroyer over Gardelegen, East Germany, in 1964.

The MiG-21 is an early air unit available after researching Rocketry. Although weaker than more advanced Jets unlocked later, the cheaper production and maintenance costs allow it to be a great aircraft for export and quickly become a fearsome sight in the skies.

Mechanized Infantry are stronger and faster than regular Infantry. Although fast, Mech Infantry cannot move after combat like Tanks; their primary responsibility is, as always, to take and hold the ground.

Giant, but fast, this is the battle machine of the future. Since it is remotely controlled by its pilot, it has no fears and never feels pain. Thus, these debuff effects - "Sundered", "Slowed Down", "Charged Damage", "Target Marked", prove to be useless on it. All of these make it the strongest defender unit in the game. It can also survive any strategic nuclear weapons' blasts including the ICBM. However, its CPU will be affected by enemy EMP attack and suffer from Collateral Damage and Area of Effect Damage, which cannot be avoided by remote-control.

A horse archer, horsed archer, or mounted archer is a cavalryman armed with a bow, able to shoot while riding from horseback. Archery has occasionally been used from the backs of other riding animals.

Mehal Sefari are the backbone of the Ethiopian army. They start with promotions that give them bonuses fighting in rough terrain and near their capital. They are slightly cheaper to build than the Rifleman that they replace.

A militia generally is an army or other fighting unit that is composed of non-professional fighters, citizens of a nation or subjects of a state or government who can be called upon to enter a combat situation, as opposed to a professional force of regular, full-time military personnel, or historically, members of the warrior nobility class.

The Missile Cruiser is a modern warship. It's fast and tough, carries a mean Ranged Combat punch and is pretty good at intercepting enemy aircraft. Most importantly, the Missile Cruiser can carry Guided Missiles and Nuclear Missiles, allowing you to carry these deadly weapons right up to the enemy's shore. Missile Cruisers combined with carriers and submarines make a fiendishly powerful armada.

Can be purchased with [ICON_PEACE] Faith in any city with a majority Religion. Once adjacent to a city they can spread their religion to it (expending the Missionary after the second use). If a Missionary enters another civilization without Open Borders, their Religious Strength is reduced each turn. Once their Religious Strength reaches zero, they are destroyed.
Anti-aircraft warfare or counter-air defence is defined by NATO as "all measures designed to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air action.

Mobile SAM (surface-to-air) units provide an advancing army with anti-air defense. Mobile SAM units can intercept and shoot at enemy aircraft bombing targets within 2 hexes (but only one unit per turn). These units are fairly vulnerable to non-air attack and should be accompanied by infantry or armor.
Modern Armor is just like its predecessor, the Tank, only more-so. Modern Armor is much stronger than the Tank unit and possesses all the Tank's abilities, such as moving after combat.

Destroyers (with a DD hull classification symbol) primarily perform anti-submarine warfare duty while guided missile destroyers (DDGs) are multi-mission (anti-submarine, anti-aircraft and anti-surface warfare) surface combatants, with an emphasis on anti-surface warfare.

Counterweight trebuchets do not appear with certainty in Chinese historical records until about 1268, when the Mongols laid siege to Fancheng and Xiangyang. At the Siege of Fancheng and Xiangyang, the Mongol army, unable to capture the cities despite besieging the Song defenders for years, brought in two Persian engineers who built hinged counterweight trebuchets. These engines were called by the Chinese historians the Huihui Pao (回回砲)("huihui" means Muslim) or Xiangyang Pao (襄陽砲), because they were first encountered in that battle.
A monitor was the class of relatively small warship which was neither fast nor strongly armoured but carried disproportionately large guns.

Motorising infantry is the first stage towards the mechanisation of an army. Civilian trucks are readily adaptable to military uses of transporting soldiers, towing guns, and carrying equipment and supplies. This greatly increases the strategic mobility of infantry units, which would otherwise rely on marches or railroads. In practice, armies have found it advantageous to develop trucks to military specifications, such as all-wheel drive, in order to have vehicles that function reliably in extremes of weather and terrain.

The Musketman is the first gunpowder unit in the game, and it replaces all of the older foot-soldier types - Longswordsmen, Pikemen, and the like. It is not a ranged unit, however, and cannot attack an enemy that is more than one hex away.

The Imperial Guards of the Tang Dynasty, also known as the Forbidden Troops (traditional chinese: 禁軍, simplified Chinese: 禁军, pinyin: jìn jūn), evolved initially from honour bodyguards of the emperor and garrison of the Imperial capitals during its formation in early 7th century, into the only military force that remained under the control of the central authorities after the An Shi Rebellion which lasted from AD 755 to 763.
A galley is a type of ship that is propelled mainly by rowing. The galley is characterized by its long, slender hull, shallow draft and low clearance between sea and railing.
Select a unit that needs orders before the turn can end.
Used to remove other religions from cities. May only be obtained by purchasing with [ICON_PEACE] Faith. [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Does not require maintenance.[ENDCOLOR]

The Pathfinder is the Scout replacement, and only the Shoshone may build it. It explores as well as a Scout and fights almost as well as a Warrior. It gives a [ICON_PEACE] Faith bonus for discovering Natural Wonders. Costs more than a Scout.
The Norman Knight is the Norman Unique Unit, replacing the standard Knight. This Unit is the standard Knight augmented with the Blitz promotion, allowing it to attack more than once per turn.

Kondensator is a tactical nuclear weapon, although it shares the same attributes with the railroad gun and rocket artillery, which can cause area-of-effect damage within 1 hex, it can also damage all stacked units within its blast radius. Like strategic bombers and nuclear weapons, it will cause catastrophic civilian casualties if attacking a city. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This is a tactical nuclear weapon so it won't cause fallout and cannot be banned by the nuclear non-proliferation resolution.
The 2A3 originated during the Cold War as a response to the United States' new "Pentomic Division" tactical doctrine that emphasized heavy use of nuclear weapons including nuclear artillery.
Aircraft carriers have evolved from converted cruisers to nuclear-powered warships that carry numerous fighter planes, strike aircraft, helicopters, and other types of aircraft.

The Nuclear Missile is an upgraded, more powerful Atomic Bomb. The Nuclear Missile can be based in any city you own or aboard a Nuclear Submarine or Missile Cruiser. It can move from base to base or attack a target within its range of "12." When it detonates, a Nuclear Missile will damage (and possibly destroy) cities and destroy all units within its blast radius of 2 tiles. It is automatically destroyed when it attacks. See the rules on Nuclear Weapons for more details.

The Nuclear Submarine is tougher and stronger than the earlier model. It too is invisible to most units and can see other submarines. Most importantly, Nuclear Submarines can carry guided missiles and nuclear missiles. Like submarines, Nuclear Subs are vulnerable to enemy Destroyers, Missile Cruisers, and Subs, so send units of your own out ahead to make sure the coast is clear.

Numidian cavalry was a type of light cavalry developed by the Numidians. After they were used by Hannibal during the Second Punic War, they were described by the Roman historian Livy as "by far the best horsemen in Africa.

It is an elite hit-and-run unit focusing on rapid offensive operations with its excellent mobility. Its ranged attack ability allows it to strike the enemy safely within one-hex distance. What's more, you can use its "Rapid March" mode to gain additional movement for the current turn to send it to the frontline in time or quickly withdraw from the danger. Be aware that when entering the "Rapid March" mode, it is not allowed to attack.

"Most of the crew - not to mention your fellow jarheads - will be leaving the ship in lifeboats. They'll ride to the surface in air conditioned comfort, sipping wine, and nibbling on appetizers. Not you, however. Oh no, you're going to leave the Pillar of Autumn in a different method. Tell me boys and girls… how will you leave?" - Major Antonio

This unit is made up of a well-trained soldiers. It not only has all Special Forces Unit's Promotions after training but also can paradrop 20 tiles aways, as well as attack multiple times in its turn. Task Force 141 is made up by the best soldiers in the world for carrying out the most dangerous missions. Yeah, Captain Price and Captain MacTavish both love these missions. Don't worry if they are in trouble. Just call Nikolai to get them out and send back to your Capital.

The Kinetic Bombardment System can make all of your enemy cities capturable by one click at the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]"Start Global Kinetic Orbital Strike"[ENDCOLOR] button on unit commands panel. If you have enough melee units in position, you are able to wipe out a superpower country of more than 20 cities in one turn.
The Cobra (Turkish: Kobra) is an infantry mobility vehicle developed by Turkish firm Otokar which uses some mechanical components and sub-systems of the HMMWV.

The Janissary is an Ottoman unique unit, replacing the Musketman. The Janissary receives a significant combat bonus when on the attack. In addition, the Janissary unit automatically heals all damage when it destroys a non-Barbarian unit. This can give a Janissary army a crushing advantage against an enemy force on the defensive.

A privateer (sometimes called corsair or buccaneer) was a private person or ship authorized by a government by letters of marque to attack foreign vessels during wartime, and take them as prizes. Captured ships were subject to condemnation and sale under prize law, with the proceeds divided between the privateer shipowners and crew. Privateering was a way of mobilizing armed ships and sailors as naval auxiliaries.

The Sipahi is the Ottoman unique unit, replacing the Lancer. The Sipahi is much faster and can see one hex farther than the Lancer, although it shares the Lancer's weaknesses on defense. The Sipahi can pillage enemy improvements at no additional cost.

The T-50 is intended to be the successor to the MiG-29 and Su-27 in the Russian Air Force and serve as the basis of the Sukhoi/HAL FGFA being developed with India.[12][13] The aircraft combines supersonic cruise, stealth, maneuverability, and advanced avionics and software to overcome legacy fighter aircraft as well as ground and maritime defences. The T-50 prototype first flew on 29 January 2010 and the aircraft is slated to enter service in the Russian Air Force in 2016.[14] The prototypes and initial production batch will be delivered with heavily upgraded models of Su-27 powerplants as interim engines while a new clean-sheet design engine is currently under development.

This multirole fighter can not only give you an excellent performance in dogfight and interception missions but atack land or naval units. What's more, it is equipped with EMP Missiles, which means each shoot to the units or cities will paralyze all units within 1 hex range or cause a Blackout to the target city for one turn (this effect can multiply). Thus, this Fighter can function as a strategic weapon.

The Airborne Forces is an advanced paradropping unit specially developed to breach enemy lines. This specialized infantry acts coupled with transport airplanes which allow them to use a Paradrop maneuver to instantly move up to 20 tiles into enemy territory (he has to start from friendly territory), and then it could even use its remaining moves to take up a suitable attack position. After earning the "Blitz" Promotion, it can attack in the same turn as paradropping.

Just like the Proton Collider in Red Alert 3 for global bombardment. This superweapon can spread its damage to every visible enemy unit (33% of the damage caused to the target) across the whole map. There will be no safe place for your enemy to hide. However its combat strength is limited, it is almost impossible to kill all enemy units in one shot.

Eastern and Persian cataphracts, particularly those of the Sassanid Empire, carried bows as well as blunt-force weapons, to soften up enemy formations before an eventual attack, reflecting upon the longstanding Persian tradition of horse archery and its use in battle by successive Persian Empires.
The Immortal is the Persian unique unit, replacing the Spearman. It is slightly more powerful than the Spearman, and it heals twice as quickly. It is quite deadly against mounted units.

Zulfiqar (ذوالفقار) is an Iranian main battle tank (MBT), conceived by Brigadier General Mir-Younes Masoumzadeh, deputy ground force commander for research and self-sufficiency of the armed forces. It is named after Zulfiqar, the legendary sword of Ali, the fourth Caliph and the first Shiite Imam.

The Pikeman is a more powerful Spearman. It receives a bonus when fighting against mounted units, which makes it pretty much the only unit that can hope to stand up against a rampaging Knight. A Pikeman fortified in defensive terrain is a Knight's worst nightmare.

The PZL.23 Karaś was a Polish light bomber and reconnaissance aircraft designed in the mid-1930s by PZL in Warsaw. It was the primary Polish reconnaissance bomber in use during the Invasion of Poland.
The PZL W-3 Sokół (en: Falcon) is a Polish medium-sized, twin-engine, multipurpose helicopter manufactured by PZL-Świdnik (now AgustaWestland Świdnik).

The Winged Hussar is the Lancer replacement, and only the Polish may build it. Faster and more powerful than the Lancer, the Winged Hussar forces a defender to retreat when it inflicts more damage than it receives. A defender who cannot retreat instead takes extra damage.

This melee naval unit replaces the Caravel and is skilled at exploration. When it is in a tile next to land owned by another Civilization or City-State you are at peace with, it may perform a one-time trade mission to earn [ICON_GOLD] Gold and XP. The further the land is from your own capital, the greater the bonus, so it is best to use on distant players. Use this unit to explore the map and uncover the locations of other players.

Naval Unit that attacks as a melee unit. Starts with the first Coastal Raider promotion allowing it to earn gold from attacking coastal cities. May capture any enemy naval units it defeats as prize ships.

Units serve as the agents of your will across history. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_WAR]The professional army serves as the backbone of your military. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_GREEN]It is expensive to maintain massive standing armies, but they are cheaper than Mercenaries.[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_RED]Require [ICON_RES_MANPOWER]manpower, and [ICON_RES_IRON]strategic resources.[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_IDEOLOGY_AUTOCRACY]Mercenaries serve to augment your military capabilities, for a price. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_RED]They are relatively cheap to hire, and very expensive to maintain for extended periods.[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_GREEN]Do not require [ICON_RES_MANPOWER]manpower or [ICON_RES_IRON]strategic resources.[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_WAR]Military and [ICON_WORKER]civilian casualties, will eventually lead to [ICON_HAPPINESS_4]loss of population in your cities. Human lives are no longer mere statistics. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Due to foreign recruitment, [ICON_IDEOLOGY_AUTOCRACY]Mercenary units do not cause [ICON_HAPPINESS_1]loss of population.
Select a unit that is awaiting promotion. All units must be promoted before you may end the turn.

The protected cruiser is a type of naval cruiser of the late 19th century, so known because its armoured deck offered protection for vital machine spaces from fragments caused by exploding shells above. Protected cruisers were an alternative to the armoured cruisers, which also had a belt of armour along the sides.
A large airship which can carry 6 Land-based Aircraft. Can cross mountain and water. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Airship Carrier Project and only one can exist in the world.

A Zeppelin is a type of rigid airship named after the German Count Ferdinand von Zeppelin who pioneered rigid airship development at the beginning of the 20th century. Zeppelin's ideas were first formulated in 1874 and developed in detail in 1893.They were patented in Germany in 1895 and in the United States in 1899. After the outstanding success of the Zeppelin design, the word zeppelin came to be commonly used to refer to all rigid airships.

This large airship carrier can carry 6 Land-based Aircraft (including stealth bombers). It can serve as a floating airbase to make sure the enemy targets are within the flight range of your aircraft, especially for those early aircraft with a poor flight range. It cannot attack the enemy units on its own but it can sustain a lot of damage by its size and armor. it is highly recommended to build this airship carrier as fast as you can since the late-game aircraft like jet fighters have long flight range so they no longer need this old fashioned floating airbase. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It CANNOT load or resupply Carrier-based Aircraft.

It is a transcendal weapon which can avoid enemy fighter's interception. Also its flight range can match the next-generation bomber. However the chance is 50%, not 100%. If you don't trust your luck, do some air-sweep before its mission. This aircraft is very expensive.

The Horten H.IX, RLM designation Ho 229 (often called Gotha Go 229 because of the identity of the chosen manufacturer of the aircraft) was a German prototype fighter/bomber designed by Reimar and Walter Horten and built by Gothaer Waggonfabrik late in World War II. It was the first pure flying wing powered by jet engines.

" Here, M. Aronnax, are the several dimensions of the boat you are in. It is an elongated cylinder with conical ends. It is very like a cigar in shape, a shape already adopted in London in several constructions of the same sort. The length of this cylinder, from stem to stern, is exactly 70 m, and its maximum breadth is eight metres. It is not built on a ratio of ten to one like your long-voyage steamers, but its lines are sufficiently long, and its curves prolonged enough, to allow the water to slide off easily, and oppose no obstacle to its passage. These two dimensions enable you to obtain by a simple calculation the surface and cubic contents of the Nautilus. Its area measures 1011.45 square metres; and its contents 1,500.2 cubic metres; that is to say, when completely immersed it displaces 1500.2 cubic metres of water, or 1500.2 metric tons. " - Captain Nemo

This is the first thing which can move underwater in the game. Since nobody can see it in this era, it can freely enter other nation's territory without an open border deal. Although it is still an experimental unit armed with inferior weapons, it can still cause chaos in the enemy fleet without being detected. (You are right that The Nautilus doesn't attack with torpedoes but now it is not in the novel but in the game. We need BALANCE! )

A railway gun, also called a railroad gun, is a large artillery piece, often surplus naval ordnance, mounted on, transported by, and fired from a specially designed railway wagon. Many countries have built railway guns, but the best known are the large Krupp-built pieces used by Germany in World War I and World War II. Smaller guns were often part of an armoured train.
A siege unit that is in between a cannon and artillery. It has a 3 range , must set up, and is stronger than a canon. It cannot see as far as other units, and should be protected with other units.

The Rifleman is the gunpowder unit following the musketman. It is significantly more powerful than the musketman, giving the army with the advanced units a big advantage over civs which have not yet upgraded to the new unit.

Multiple Launch Rocket System has a better mobility than its previous version. This devastating ranged unit has a fire range of 4. Its weapon can deal damage with area of effects (100% damage to the unit on target tile, 50% "splash damage" to adjacent units). However it is less effective bombarding cities.

Roman unique unit, more powerful than the Catapult it replaces. The Ballista is an excellent siege weapon. It is extremely useful against cities, but it is quite vulnerable to attack. Be sure to protect the Ballista with other military units. The Ballista must first "set up" (1 MP) before attacking.

The Legion is the Roman unique unit, replacing the Swordsman. The Legion is more powerful than the Swordsman, making it the most powerful melee unit of the Classical Era. The Legion can also construct roads and forts and is the only non-Worker unit able to do so.

The Re Umberto class were a group of three ironclad battleships built for the Italian Navy in the 1880s and 1890s. The ships—Re Umberto, Sicilia, and Sardegna—were built as the culmination of a major naval expansion program begun in the 1870s following Italy's defeat at the Battle of Lissa in 1866.

Cossack is a Militia Unit, but its combat strength, abilities and mobility can match regular army units. Like the Landsknecht, it is ver cheap and won't cause population loss when KIA. Use it number to overwhelm your enemies!

The Sukhoi Su-27 (Russian: Сухой Су-27) (NATO reporting name: Flanker) is a twin-engine supermaneuverable fighter aircraft designed by Sukhoi. It was intended as a direct competitor for the large United States fourth-generation fighters such as the Grumman F-14 Tomcat and F-15 Eagle, with 3,530-kilometre (1,910 nmi) range, heavy aircraft ordnance, sophisticated avionics and high maneuverability. The Su-27 was designed for air superiority missions, and subsequent variants are able to perform almost all aerial warfare operations. It was designed with the Mikoyan MiG-29 as its complement.

The T-80 is a third-generation main battle tank (MBT) designed and manufactured in the Soviet Union. A development of the T-64, it entered service in 1976. The T-80U was last produced in a factory in Omsk, Russia, while the T-80UD and further-developed T-84 continue to be produced in Ukraine.
A combat vehicle, also known as a ground combat vehicle, is a self-propelled, weaponized military vehicle used for combat operations. Combat vehicles can be wheeled or tracked.
A foreign batalltion of the Territorial Defence Force, able to move after attacking. Enemy units adjacent to a Territorial Defense Force receive a -10% [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength penalty.

Unique Unit for Zelenskyy's Ukraine, able to move after attacking and costing less [ICON_PRODUCTION] to build than the Bazooka it replaces. Enemy units adjacent to a Territorial Defense Force receive a -10% [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength penalty.

The Territorial Defence Forces are the military reserve component of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. The Territorial Defence Forces were formed after the reorganization of the Territorial Defence Battalions, volunteer militias created during the War in Donbas under the command of the Ministry of Defence. Territorial Defence units existed from 2015 until 2021 in semi-organized forms until 2022 when they were formally organized into a unified defense corps under the Territorial Defence Forces. It is formed by a core of part-time reservists, usually former combat veterans, and in cases of war can be expanded to local civilian volunteers for local defense. As a result of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Territorial Defense Forces reserves were activated and many civilians joined local Territorial Defense Forces groups to fight the Russian invaders. On 25 February, during the rapid Russian offensive into Kyiv, the Ukrainian government distributed 18,000 guns for people wishing to fight in Kyiv.

Satellite Units are special late-game units in SuperPower Mod. Those units function as Wonders, which can offer their unique global effects. Some of them can only provide bonus for their launchers while others give bonus to all existing civilizations. They are very helpful to speed up your victory process, especially for a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Science Victory[ENDCOLOR]. However you should be aware that some Satellite Units with global effects may also help your opponents to catch up with you. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You must finish The Apollo program to build Satellite Units. Satellite Units must be built in cities with a spaceship factory. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Satellite Units are like Wonders. They are unique and only one of each kind can exist in the world. If one civilization successfully build out one Satellite Unit, all other civilizations are no longer able to build it. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Satellite Units must be [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Launched[ENDCOLOR] to be functional. You can launch those Satellite Units simply by moving them to your [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital and press the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]"Launch Satellite"[ENDCOLOR] button in the unit command panel. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]You CANNOT build Satellite Units if the Science Victory is disabled.[ENDCOLOR]
Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Remove all Fallout caused by nuclear explosion on the Map. This effect is one-time and can only be used once in a game.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"War. War never changes."[NEWLINE] -Narration in Fallout intro by Ron Perlman [NEWLINE]

Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives 1 free Technology and Great Scientists provide 33% more [ICON_RESEARCH] Science when used to discover new technology. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Other Nations receive 1 free Technology.

Apollo 11 was the first spaceflight that landed humans on the Moon. Americans Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on July 20, 1969, at 20:18 UTC (46 years ago). Armstrong became the first to step onto the lunar surface six hours later on July 21 at 02:56 UTC; Aldrin joined him about 20 minutes later. They spent about two and a quarter hours together outside the spacecraft, and collected 47.5 pounds (21.5 kg) of lunar material for return to Earth. The third member of the mission, Michael Collins, piloted the command spacecraft alone in lunar orbit, until Armstrong and Aldrin returned to it just under a day later for the trip back to Earth.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"That's one small step for a man, one giant leap for mankind."[NEWLINE] -Neil Alden Armstrong[NEWLINE]

Satellite Unit with Exclusive Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Enemy land units must spend 1 extra [ICON_MOVES] Movement Point when inside the Launcher's territory. If the Launcher's [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital is lost, this satellite unit will no longer effective.

Electronic counter-countermeasures (ECCM) is a part of electronic warfare which includes a variety of practices which attempt to reduce or eliminate the effect of electronic countermeasures (ECM) on electronic sensors aboard vehicles, ships and aircraft and weapons such as missiles. ECCM is also known as electronic protective measures (EPM), chiefly in Europe. In practice, EPM often means resistance to jamming.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No battle plan survives contact with the enemy."[NEWLINE] -Colin Powell[NEWLINE]

Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]All Tundra Tiles and Snow Tiles on the map will yield the same output as Plains. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives +15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production output for all cities.

Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites (GOES) GOES satellites provide the kind of continuous monitoring necessary for intensive data analysis. They circle the Earth in a geosynchronous orbit, which means they orbit the equatorial plane of the Earth at a speed matching the Earth's rotation.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm hopeful that we'll be able to study the ocean before we destroy it."[NEWLINE] -James Cameron[NEWLINE]
Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher's all civlian units +4 [ICON_MOVES] Movement. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Other Nations' all civlian units +2 [ICON_MOVES] Movement.

The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a space-based navigation system that provides location and time information in all weather conditions, anywhere on or near the Earth where there is an unobstructed line of sight to four or more GPS satellites. The system provides critical capabilities to military, civil, and commercial users around the world. The United States government created the system, maintains it, and makes it freely accessible to anyone with a GPS receiver.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“In this new age of GPS, Google Earth and multidimensional digital maps, mapping is suddenly hugely relevant again.”[NEWLINE] -Hans-Ulrich Obrist[NEWLINE]
Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives 2 Great Scientists. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Other Nations receive 1 Great Scientist.
The Hubble Space Telescope (HST) is a space telescope that was launched into low Earth orbit in 1990, and remains in operation.

Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher's all military units +1 sight and +15% [ICON_STRENGTH] Comabt Strength when fighting outside friendly territory. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Other Nations' all military units +1 sight.

A reconnaissance satellite (commonly, although unofficially, referred to as a spy satellite) is an Earth observation satellite or communications satellite deployed for military or intelligence applications.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“The threat of a world war is no more.”[NEWLINE] -Mikhail Gorbachev[NEWLINE]
Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+4 quantity for each Stargic Resource on the map. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives +8 quantity for each Stargic Resource.

Earth observation satellites are satellites specifically designed for Earth observation from orbit, similar to spy satellites but intended for non-military uses such as environmental monitoring, meteorology, map making etc.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great."[NEWLINE] -John D. Rockefeller[NEWLINE]
Satellite Unit with Exclusive Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher will produce 10,000 [ICON_TOURISM] to all Civilizations (one-time effect).

Sputnik 1 (/ˈspʌtnɪk/; Russian: Спутник-1 [ˈsputnʲɪk] "Satellite-1", or ПС-1 ["PS-1", i.e., Russian: Простейший Спутник-1 "Elementary Satellite 1"]) was the first artificial Earth satellite. The Soviet Union launched it into an elliptical low Earth orbit on 4 October 1957. It was a 58 cm (23 in) diameter polished metal sphere, with four external radio antennae to broadcast radio pulses.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Myth has become reality: Earth's gravity conquered" [NEWLINE] -French daily Le Figaro[NEWLINE]

Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives +1 [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen in each city and +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness per city, also receives 1 Great Great Engineer. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Other Nations receive 1 Great Engineer.

Tiangong-1 (Chinese: 天宫一号; pinyin: Tiāngōng yīhào; literally: "Heavenly Palace 1") is China's first space station, serving as both a manned laboratory and an experimental testbed to demonstrate orbital rendezvous and docking capabilities. Launched unmanned aboard a Long March 2F/G rocket on 29 September 2011, it is the first operational component of the Tiangong program, which aims to place a larger, modular station into orbit by 2023.
[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The last key can always open the gate."[NEWLINE] -Qian Xuesen[NEWLINE]

Satellite Unit with Global Effect:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]All [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Desert Tiles without [ENDCOLOR] on the map will yield the same output as Grassland. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The Launcher receives +15% [ICON_FOOD] Food output for all cities.

Weather modding is the act of intentionally manipulating or altering the weather. The most common form of weather modification is cloud seeding to increase rain or snow, usually for the purpose of increasing the local water supply. Weather modification can also have the goal of preventing damaging weather, such as hail or hurricanes, from occurring; or of provoking damaging weather against the enemy, as a tactic of military or economic warfare. Weather modification in warfare has been banned by the United Nations.

The Huscarl is the Unique Unit for Anglo-Saxon England, replacing the Longswordsman. This Unit gains the Cover I and Bonus vs. Mounted (50) promotions for its ability to create shield walls when faced with attack.
This early unit can attack but is weak. However, it can move through difficult terrain as though it were clear (all tiles cost 1mp per hex). Use it for world exploration.

Naval Unit used to specializes in attacking coastal cities to earn gold and capturing enemy ships. Only the Dutch may build it. Heals outside friendly territory. Starts with the first two Coastal Raider promotions allowing it to earn gold from attacking coastal cities. May capture any enemy naval units it defeats as prize ships.

Self-propelled artillery (also called mobile artillery or locomotive artillery) is artillery equipped with its own propulsion system to move towards its target. Within the term are covered self-propelled guns (or howitzers) and rocket artillery. They are high mobility vehicles, usually based on caterpillar track carrying either a large howitzer or other field gun or alternatively a mortar or some form of rocket or missile launcher. They are usually used for long-range indirect bombardment support on the battlefield.

A Settler can either found a new city or join one of your existing Cities to become one new [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen. Exactly speaking, the "Settler" is made up of one [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen in the city where it is trained. As a result, when it is trained, the population of the city will reduce by 1 and create [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If you want it to found a new city, just click "Found" as in original Civ5 game. If join other Cities, just simply move it into the city you wish it to join and click "Move into the City". The Settler Unit will disapear and the [ICON_CITIZEN] Population of the city will increase by 1. Be aware it won't join a City currently in Resistance or being razed. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A portion of surplus food is turned into production towards the Settler. The portion that is converted is significantly less once you go past a surplus of [ICON_FOOD] Food. In a city with very few production tiles, it is advisable to have a surplus of [ICON_FOOD] Food while building a Settler. Since building the Settler won't stop the growth of City, you can no longer "cheat" with building Settlers to rid starvation! [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settlers are civilians with limited survival skills, thus they will takes [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]damage[ENDCOLOR] if ends turn in outside friendly territory. You should use combat units with medic promotion to accompany them for the long trip. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If a Settler is captured by another civilization, it will be destroyed other than becoming a worker.

A ship of the line was a type of naval warship constructed from the 17th through to the mid-19th century to take part in the naval tactic known as the line of battle, in which two columns of opposing warships would manoeuvre to bring the greatest weight of broadside firepower to bear. Since these engagements were almost invariably won by the heaviest ships carrying the most powerful guns, the natural progression was to build sailing vessels that were the largest and most powerful of their time.
The Comanche Riders replaces the Cavalry, and only the Shoshone may build it. Cheaper and faster than the base unit.

The Pathfinder is the Scout replacement, and only the Shoshone may build it. It explores as well as a Scout and fights almost as well as a Warrior. It allows the player to choose the benefit when uncovering an ancient ruin. Costs more than a Scout.
Monk is the unique religious unit of Siam, replacing the Missionary. It has better mobility and religious strength. It can Spreads religion to other cities three times.

This is the Siamese unique unit, replacing the Knight. The Naresuan's Elephant unit is slower than a Knight but it is more powerful. Like the Knight the Naresuan's Elephant can move after attacking. Equipped with spears, the Elephant gets a significant combat bonus when attacking other mounted units.
Most advanced airship unit. May act as base for a Flyer. Powerful attacks, but vulnerable to Flyers.

The Sky Fortress is the most advanced type of airship unit, and houses significant firepower. Not only can it use its cannons to attack land targets and other airships, but also it can act as a mobile base for a Flyer. With a Flyer running strikes on nearby airship units, the Sky Fortress poses a serious threat to many types of units, but is still vulnerable to enemy Flyers and Anti-Air Guns.

The majestic Sky Fortress is quite a sight to behold. Much larger than the airship, it casts a wide shadow on the ground below that strikes fear into the hearts of foes. It is outfitted with heavy weaponry, but kept aloft through advanced applications of aetherium's lift properties. Inside the ship's body are a variety of accommodations: war rooms used by generals above the battlefield, a small hangar which can host a squadron of Flyers, and even parlors for recreation. The Sky Fortress became the centerpiece of airship fleets, a mobile command center that could rain death on the land below and blow enemy airships out of the sky.

A cog (or cog-built vessels) is a type of ship that first appeared in the 10th century, and was widely used from around the 12th century on. Cogs were generally built of oak, which was an abundant timber in the Baltic region of Prussia. This vessel was fitted with a single mast and a square-rigged single sail. These vessels were mostly associated with seagoing trade in medieval Europe, especially the Hanseatic League, particularly in the Baltic Sea region.
The Songhai Empire held a great naval fleet and planned to cross the Atlantic Ocean. Unfortunately they failed to set off before the disintegration of the empire.

This is a Songhai unique unit, replacing the Knight. This unit has the same statistics as the Knight, but it is significantly better at attacking cities. The Mandekalu Cavalry can move after attacking. Its speed makes it difficult for an enemy to build a defensive line before the Mandekalu Cavalry reaches the target.

The Spanish Armada (Spanish: Grande y Felicísima Armada or Armada Invencible, literally "Great and Most Fortunate Navy" or "Invincible Fleet") was a Spanish fleet of 130 ships that sailed from A Coruña in August 1588 under the command of the Duke of Medina Sidonia with the purpose of escorting an army from Flanders to invade England.

O ye men who dwell in the streets of broad Lacedaemon![NEWLINE]Honor the festival of the Carneia!! Otherwise,[NEWLINE]Either your glorious town shall be sacked by the children of Perseus,[NEWLINE]Or, in exchange, must all through the whole Laconian country[NEWLINE]Mourn for the loss of a king, descendant of great Heracles.
It could be the best unit for defensive actions. Deployed in the suitable terrain, it can hold up the whole enemy army from marching. However it has no bonuses attacking enemy units.

The Spearman is the first melee unit available after the Warrior. It is just slightly more powerful than the Warrior. However, it gets a significant combat bonus against mounted units (Chariot Archer, Horsemen and so forth).

SR71 "Black Bird" is not a fighter but a reconnaissance aircraft. It cannot attack the enemy but can carry out aerial reconnaissance to offer intels for your air force and give you an edge in air combat or air strike. Click the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]"Perform Long-range Reconnaissance Mission"[ENDCOLOR] on the unit commands panel to offer a temporarily Combat Bonus (+25%) for all of your aircraft in this turn. SR71 "Black Bird" flies high in the sky where no fighters can reach, so it is indestructible unless its city is breached.
Can carry up to 9 Nuclear Missiles.

A ballistic missile submarine is a submarine equipped to launch submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs) with nuclear warheads. In the US Navy they have the designation SSBN and they are nicknamed 'boomers', a common term of art used in everyday briefings and base operations. Virtually all ballistic missile submarines are nuclear powered and are therefore nuclear submarines.

The SSBN is the only unit can load and launch Nuclear Missile, ICBM and EMP missiles. One SSBN can destroy the whole civilization! Besides being a stealthy missile carrier, it is also equipped with torpedoes and can fight like a normal nuclear attack submarine.

Stealth aircraft are designed to avoid detection using a variety of advanced technologies that reduce reflection/emission of radar, infrared, visible light, radio-frequency (RF) spectrum, and audio, collectively known as stealth technology.

The Stealth Bomber is an upgraded bomber, possessing increased range, a greater Ranged Combat Strength, and an increased ability to avoid enemy anti-aircraft and fighters. The Stealth Bomber has the "air recon" ability, which means that everything within 6 tiles of its starting location is visible at the beginning of the turn. Note that Stealth Bombers cannot be transported aboard Carriers. See the rules on Aircraft for more information.

A Stealth Helicopter which can move invisible to most of the enemy units and spot enemy stealthy units. It has the skill of "Target Marking", which will make nearby enemy units vulnerable to your artillery fire and airstrikes. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires Light Helicopter Experimental Program and only one can exist in the world.

The Boeing-Sikorsky RAH-66 Comanche was an advanced five-blade armed reconnaissance and attack helicopter designed for the United States Army. The RAH-66 program was canceled in 2004, before mass production began, after nearly US$7 billion was spent on the program.

This stealth helicopter can move stealthily and attack enemy units within 2-hex range. However this is not the best way to use it.
